| Meet **Mark Walker**

Congressman Mark Walker started his career in finance and, after earning his theology degree, Walker served 16 years as a pastor. In 2014, Walker stepped away from ministry and made a successful run for the U.S. Congress defeating a host of elected politicians. In 2015, Congressman Walker became the first member in an inaugural term to be elected Chair of the Republican Study Committee (RSC) - the largest caucus in Congress with 160 members and a position previously held by Vice President Pence and Congressman Jim Jordan.

In 2018, Walker was elected as Vice Chair of the entire conference, becoming the highest rated conservative to serve in the top four leadership positions in Congress. Walker is also the last member of Congress to secure a floor vote on a balanced budget amendment and led the House on HBCU initiatives winning the United Negro College Fund President’s list award. Congressman Walker served on multiple committees and in 2019, Walker was appointed to ranking member on the Committee on Homeland Security’s Intelligence and Counter-Terrorism’s subcommittee. Walker was co-chair of the bicameral prayer caucus for five years and also won the GOP MVP award as the starting pitcher on the Republican baseball team for the annual charity game.

Congressman Walker was redistricted out of his seat and stepped away from Congress in 2021. Walker ran for U.S. Senate in 2022 and was endorsed by Senators Tim Scott and James Lankford, Gov. Mike Huckabee, Hall of Fame Coach Tony Dungy and more than 200 pastors across North Carolina. Walker is currently the president of a political consulting business called Advancing Hope USA, and advocated for the two North Carolina Supreme Court candidates and 4 North Carolina Court of Appeals candidates through his independent expenditure organization, Win the Courts during this past general election. body:
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=30597%2E3422442%2Eiabxva)
Today’s Oversight Committee Hearing on Republicans’ impeachment inquiry into President Biden included more BS than when my kids call me in Washington and tell me they washed all the dishes.
_A quick step back: Kevin McCarthy opened this impeachment inquiry because he is beholden to a group of extreme members of his party—**think Matt Gaetz.** Kevin would like to keep that Speaker’s gavel, so with no regard for the facts, he’s opened an impeachment inquiry to appease them, _without_ bringing this issue to the House floor for a vote._
When Democrats opened an impeachment inquiry into Trump in 2019, we voted to do so after carefully considering the evidence. Prior to taking the vote to open an inquiry, Kevin McCarthy said **an impeachment inquiry without a floor vote would “create a process devoid of any merit or legitimacy.”**
**So today, 2019-Kevin-McCarthy and I found something we agree on. This whole impeachment inquiry is not legitimate and does not have merit.**
I’ll keep calling out BS when I see it—but I need your help to do so. **[We’re facing our end-of-quarter federal fundraising deadline on Saturday, and I’d be so appreciative of anything you can chip in.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20230928-2?refcode=EMAL28_2_KEV_20230928_V1_F&refcode2=30597_3422442_iabxva&akid=30597%2E3422442%2Eiabxva)

body:
Honoring a WW2 Veteran who served at Pearl Harbor | | |
---
| |
---
| |
# Party of the Constitution
---
On December 7th, we commemorate the day that changed the world, and we pay tribute to World War II veteran Eleanor Carlson, who turns 100 years old today.
Eleanor Sarah Carlson Tucker was born in Roscommon, Michigan, and grew up on a farm. She proudly spoke about her beloved cow.
In 1941, she and her brother John graduated from high school in the Gerrish Higgins School District. During her time there, she was the editor of the class yearbook, Mikenauk, and served as the Student Council Financial Secretary in 1940. She also acted in the senior play, "Meet the Folks," alongside her brother. Additionally, she was one of 18 students in the graduating class and had the honor of being the "Salutatory" speaker.
**Then came World War 2.**
Eleanor had three brothers who enlisted - two in the US Army and one in the US Navy.On May 20th, 1944, Eleanor made the proud decision to enlist in the US Marines. After being assigned active duty on October 16th, she was sent to Pearl Harbor from Quantico, VA in 1945. While in VA, she served as the secretary of the Marine Corps Rifle Range and was allowed to fire a rifle, despite it not being a common opportunity for women. When the war ended, she was on a ship in the ocean and heard the announcement over loudspeakers. She remembers the emotional scene as everyone cried, laughed, and started dancing with each other.
She was honorably discharged from her station at Pearl Harbor on July 3rd, 1946, with the rank of Corporal.
She took advantage of the government benefit that allowed honorably discharged service personnel to attend college and enrolled at Michigan State College (before it became a university). She graduated on June 7th, 1953.
Upon her return to Roscommon, she attended a garden party at her sister Elizabeth's house, where she met her future husband, Theodore Tucker. Ted worked as a DNR Forester, which caused them to relocate several times within the state. Together, they had one child named Sarah. Eleanor and Ted decided that Sarah should complete her education in Roscommon and thus returned to the area, settling in the Gerrish Higgins School District for Sarah's high school years. After graduating, Sarah enrolled at Central Michigan College, but unfortunately, she fell ill and passed away in 1979. Eleanor and Ted retired in Roscommon and resided near Wallace Park. They remained active in the community until Ted's sudden passing in September 1999.
Eleanor is a kind-hearted and benevolent woman who has generously donated to various community groups. She is actively involved with the VFW Post, historical society, and community center. In honor of her daughter Sarah, she funded a community foundation grant which is still in effect.
When someone called Eleanor a “former marine”, she quickly corrected them, stating that “once a marine always a marine”. After that, nobody made that mistake again.
**Here's to many more happy birthdays, Eleanor, you wonderful patriot!**

body:
| To be frank: Kevin McCarthy and the GOP House majority cannot get their s#*t together.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=4160%2E5257348%2ExkOlOZ)
Hey Derek, it’s Adam. I just finished on _MSNBC_.
Before I share the quick details, can you pitch in to my campaign before midnight? My FEC deadline is in 48 hours: **[secure.actblue.com/donate/sep2023_abs_em](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=sep2023_abs_em.H56YJI&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_AC30_20230928_PM1_V1_S1&email=&amount=3&t=4&akid=4160%2E5257348%2ExkOlOZ)**
To be frank: Kevin McCarthy and the GOP House majority cannot get their s#*t together.
They are poised to shut down the government at midnight on Saturday — and hundreds of thousands of federal workers will be the ones suffering as they go without pay.
Even Mitch McConnell was able to find a compromise with Senate Democrats to pass a continuing resolution. **McCarthy — the weakest Speaker in the history of the U.S. House of Representatives — can’t.**
Talk about not fit to govern.
And the ringleader of this far-right circus, Donald Trump, is coming to California tomorrow to headline the California Republican Party convention before holding a massive fundraiser in Costa Mesa right before the FEC deadline closes.
I’ve been at the Capitol past midnight most nights this week working to keep the lights on. Which is what Kevin McCarthy and the MAGA brigade _should_ be doing — you know, their job. Frankly, with a shutdown looming, I haven’t had time to focus on my campaign’s FEC deadline on Saturday. If there’s anything you can add to help my team make up the difference before our deadline, I’d appreciate it: **[secure.actblue.com/donate/sep2023_abs_em](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=sep2023_abs_em.H56YJI&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_AC30_20230928_PM1_V1_S1&email=&amount=3&t=5&akid=4160%2E5257348%2ExkOlOZ)**
I’ll keep you posted. And I will continue to do everything in my power to keep the lights on, and make sure our service members, federal firefighters and other workers don’t miss a paycheck.
Thanks for your help,
Adam

If we want to change the future of our state through local elections in 2023 and statewide elections in 2024, it starts now!

http://wsrp.org
Ballots Are Out, Vote By November 2nd!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WeGlgXqOx-Y

With ballots out, now is the perfect time to get out there and volunteer on a conservative campaign. Every door you knock on in these local races matter a lot and the results of this election year will be used as a bellwether for the 2022 midterms.

We are also hosting another WSRP Statewide Day Of Action on Saturday, October 30th! Bring a friend or neighbor to volunteer for a few hours to help local conservatives win in November! Sign up here to join our Statewide Day Of Action! (https://form.jotform.com/212737084845058)
State Sen. Gildon On Vaccine Mandates
https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws
State Senator Chris Gildon (R - Puyallup) joins the podcast this week to discuss vaccine mandates, anti-policing laws, the Long-Term Care Tax, and how he got his start in politics. WAGOP is now on Apple Podcasts and Spotify, follow us and never miss an episode! Listen here. (https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws)
Republican Leaders Fight Inslee's Mandate
Thanks to our Republican leaders in the State House and Senate for fighting back and offering a strong rebuke of Inslee's harmful vaccine mandate. Below is an excerpt of their most recent statement to the press:

“We are already experiencing higher prices and empty shelves partially as a result of COVID's shutdowns and workforce shortages. Today's deadline, with its unnecessarily hardline consequences, will only make that worse when hundreds, if not thousands, lose their jobs and are denied unemployment benefits. It also threatens public safety by reducing our police forces at a time when crime is already rising. People feel unsafe. They are afraid of what criminals will do when there are even fewer law enforcement officers to respond. And they are worried about people's chances of survival if there aren't enough first responders to help in an emergency. The governor underestimates the potential impact of his actions.

“Coercion, intimidation, threats and public shaming are not tactics a leader should be using against the people. The governor's obvious disdain for those who are choosing to lose their jobs rather than compromise their right to make their own medical decisions is unhelpful. He is dividing the public – segregating us and turning people against each other. Yesterday, even unvaccinated health-care workers were heroes. Today, they become villains in the governor's narrative."

Read the full statement. (https://jtwilcox.houserepublicans.wa.gov/2021/10/18/republican-leaders-todays-vaccine-deadline-threatens-critical-services-public-safety/?fbclid=IwAR3WxI9H29hbbmfbZhdkDS9QjqdVd2TIRCdjNjUkUlLdeThtbUjK_WBWJuw)
Smiley Campaign Shows Grassroots Support In Latest Fundraising Quarter
Tiffany Smiley is fighting hard to retire Patty Murray and her latest fundraising numbers show not only has Tiffany raised more than $1.6 million but she also has unequivocal grassroots support, with over 10,000 donors from Washington State. Flipping a U.S. Senate seat is hard work but Tiffany has shown in the only 5 months since starting her campaign, that she is a force to be reckoned with. Learn more about how Tiffany stands on the issues here (https://www.smileyforwashington.com/issues) .

### Struggling workers challenging employers from coast-to-coast inspired dueling acts of theater from presidential candidates. Who showed solidarity with autoworkers on strike? Neither Biden nor Trump.

From [Hollywood](https://substack.com/redirect/0189b3fd-18d8-42e2-9770-38a97feaf26b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to [Detroit](https://substack.com/redirect/94fad7d8-18fd-4e67-9928-36077eadf583?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), workers across the country have organized and taken action to demand fair wages and benefits long denied by their employers. Their strikes and union organizing drives, targeting businesses from [Starbucks](https://substack.com/redirect/5f4c7dd2-b414-44c2-be43-a21167ecf3eb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [Amazon](https://substack.com/redirect/f6ea3ffa-e248-4548-b26c-517236a03a1a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to Universal and Paramount Studios, have predictably attracted interest from political parties and candidates.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/25a5383f-1916-4e0c-a249-4c11c19e88c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
President Biden joined a UAW picket line this week, prompting writers and editors to breathlessly [declare](https://substack.com/redirect/deb2942b-8d7c-47b5-aaed-3d47fca6c452?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) him the first sitting U.S. president to show such supposed solidarity with labor--even though he has repeatedly denied labor's most urgent demands.
Trump also visited an auto plant this week, while managing to [avoid](https://substack.com/redirect/926ed546-164c-43cc-857b-b13df1eb4c74?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) any union members. Even though his policies in office relentlessly favored employers over workers, he relied on [support from workers](https://substack.com/redirect/3b8c6268-08d9-46c1-85a8-18129247c7c1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) disaffected with Democrats to win the White House in 2020.
Around the world, petty despots have often bribed their subjects into accepting their authority. That's been the case in every petrostate supported by the Pentagon, particularly Saudi Arabia. The political strategy embraced at points by both [Sen. Josh] Hawley and Trump reflects that proposed bargain coming home to roost.
Given the role of the auto industry in the Midwest--and the pivotal role of Midwestern states like Michigan and Ohio in recent presidential elections--the stakes are higher than they might appear from afar.
That's one reason it's so important to look beyond the corporate political parties & candidates that are vying to co-opt labor, in order to discern which of the voices contending for the White House has shown true solidarity.
If my thoughts can help inform others, please share this post with them!
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=1018597&post_id=137458997&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTM3NDU4OTk3LCJpYXQiOjE2OTU5NTQzNDcsImV4cCI6MTY5ODU0NjM0NywiaXNzIjoicHViLTEwMTg1OTciLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.LeDSKRqnLtBzixrBvTa3qFh474so6J6VZensB-g8-u0)
The contrast between the candidates' events is important to observe, as is the complicity of journalists characterizing either Biden or Trump as pro-labor--despite documented public policy records revealing a shamelessly shared commitment to capital rather than working people.
When I challenged a leading corporate Democrat myself, I had to painfully observe the [gullibility of writers and journalists](https://substack.com/redirect/f7166612-5558-4d64-82cb-dfb1f71ae59f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) who create cults of personality surrounding government officials, rather than holding them accountable.
It's almost as if news reporters have jumped in to try to fill the shoes of Hollywood writers & actors who are [returning to work](https://substack.com/redirect/6799d7d6-d4a6-4ce7-9aca-0447db374849?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) after an agreement negotiated this week ended a five-month strike.
Over 20,000 people read this publication. Fewer than 100 support it. If a few free subscribers are able to join on a paid basis, it would help put me in a position to publish more frequently and educate readers across a broader variety of topics.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..f6gyrQ_r09ziVjnH3u3GrLnl2AlIP_2_5Iw-zjrl-hs?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=137458997)
### **Corporate Democrats embrace political theater rather than solidarity**
Biden's visit to a picket line is theater from a president [in political crisis](https://substack.com/redirect/520f6b0d-ca1e-4d75-b984-22b0f8f17188?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) looking for any straw he can grasp. Imagining him to be "a pro-worker president" requires ignoring an unfortunate history with far too many examples. Ultimately, undermining worker rights and enabling an upward transfer of wealth to the rich is an agenda that both Biden and Trump have long shared.
Biden's decisions marginalizing workers have taken many shapes...

name: Tim Holbert, American Veterans Center
subject: Help me teach our children the bravery of WWII veterans
body:
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
| | | | [](http://trk.libertyledger._c291cmNlX2NvZGU9TExPNDMxODUifQ/hAw3whxWoVZgAjNJ1Q57HA)
---
Fellow American, Our schools used to teach every child about D-Day. Among the thousands of heroes of the longest day were the 12 soldiers who received the Medal of Honor for their courage and valor... but that's no longer the case. WAs our Greatest Generation has passed, we have failed to teach our children the legacy of service, honor, and sacrifice of the men who fought their way into Hitler's Fortress Europe. In a recent poll of High School Seniors:
* 72% Didn't know we fought Hitler during World War II.
* 87% Didn't know we entered WWII because of the attacks on Pearl Harbor.
* 60% Didn't know which countries we fought in WWII
* 13% Thought General Dwight Eisenhower was a general from the Civil War

Fellow American, American kids are not being taught our nation's history. According to 'The Nation's Report Card,' America's high schoolers' proficiency in U.S. History and Civics is at its lowest level in nearly 30 years. They know little of the immense courage our troops displayed fighting for their freedoms in the Second World War, and they know little of the heroes who gave their life in service to our country. In fact, most Americans these days know next to nothing about World War II and the millions of young soldiers who put their lives on the line to serve their country in the war, let alone in Korea or Vietnam. To help educate young Americans about the selfless, patriotic, and courageous heroes in WWII, the American Veterans Center created a limited-edition booklet - **_A Mighty Endeavor: Operation Overlord through the Eyes of D-Day's Greatest Heroes._** [**For the next 24 hours, I'm holding a copy of this brand new, one-of-a-kind booklet for you, Fellow American. With your gift of any amount today, a copy of _A Mighty Endeavor_ will be yours to share with family and friends.**](http://trk.libertyledger._c291cmNlX2NvZGU9TExPNDMxODUifQ/SZoeH2uakbarGuXuuELKcQ)
---
[Claim your copy of **_A Mighty Endeavor_**](http://trk.libertyledger._c291cmNlX2NvZGU9TExPNDMxODUifQ/tp9Jah3gpvSMZPGJ7qucUg)
---
[](http://trk.libertyledger._c291cmNlX2NvZGU9TExPNDMxODUifQ/q6Dltt3UeuBbPLqjqLXRhQ)
---
Every one of the 156,000 men who stormed the beaches of Normandy on that bloodyday is a hero in my book. It took real guts to run head-first into a hailstorm of bullets and mortar rounds. We all hope nobody ever needs to experience something like it again. But it is essential we remember, and learn. The AVC is devoted to preserving their history, so that today's young Americans - and those in generations to come - can learn from the heroes you and I grew up idolizing. The 12 heroes who received the Medal of Honor showed so much courage and valor in the invasion of Normandy, that they were individually chosen to receive our nation's highest honor. All Americans should read the stories and know of these heroes who have been all but forgotten. The [**American Veterans Center is committed to bringing the legacy of the greatest generation to the latest generation, and with your gift today, we can preserve the legacy of America's World War II veterans.**](http://trk.libertyledger._c291cmNlX2NvZGU9TExPNDMxODUifQ/FZlWBnZ1s1DqAChh37QPIw) As a token of my thanks for your support, I'll send you a limited-edition copy of **_A Mighty Endeavor_**. When you receive it, I have just one request; please share it with a loved one. Show them these stories and talk about how important their legacy is to our history. But, please let me know in the next 24 hours if you're claiming your copy! It is my hope that you'll share this booklet with your children, grandchildren, and neighbors and tell them all about D-Day.
---
[Claim your copy of **_A Mighty Endeavor_**](http://trk.libertyledger._c291cmNlX2NvZGU9TExPNDMxODUifQ/GPNjVuKKU8vXHyjJcL2_rA)
---
Fellow American, we must share the TRUTH about American WWII veterans with America's youth - we cannot fail them any longer. We must educate our nation's children with messages of the D-Day heroes who were up against a battle-hardened enemy, whose very actions preserved the freedoms we enjoy today. [**Please support American Veterans Center's mission to fight the historical ignorance plaguing today's culture and teach America's young people what real service meant during WWII.**](http://trk.libertyledger._c291cmNlX2NvZGU9TExPNDMxODUifQ/T5BJIPr_9IOylgwEQaZF9g) Whether you can afford to donate $15, $35, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000, or any other amount - I'll send along your copy of **_A Mighty Endeavor: Operation Overlord through the Eyes of D-Day's Greatest Heroes_** as a "thank you" for your support of our bravest Americans. Thank you and God bless,
---
Tim HolbertAmerican Veterans Center

body:
The second Republican debate went just as well as we knew it would. We faced the nation, rose to the occasion, and won.

---
| | | | | | | | | | [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z4tp8veo7ptmdm2m5nrgee7dq2scnq8sv2ha663g_rp22sh2s8i66p75cjge8or6clh2bs)
---
Friend, There is no clearer contrast between Joe Biden and the energy we brought to the stage last night at the second Republican debate. We just gave the nation a preview of what the nation will see in the 2024 general election, and the response we're getting now is unbelievable. Now is the time to take action. We put in the work standing up to the challengers last night, but we are just getting started. We are facing a chance to maximize our momentum TODAY if we step up and make this victory a steppingstone to the next stage of our campaign, **[but that means coming together to earn an unprecedented show of support for our mission.](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zmqptrh1ae4hc0ilfe42bu5h5skf9s87d97eis9o_rp22sh2s8i66p75cjge8or6clh2bs "but that means coming together to earn an unprecedented show of support for our mission.")**

| | [SUPPORT THE CAMPAIGN NOW: DONATE $25 HERE](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z9nq31ngrlql0vc0i50qjhaq2vleh8gkvpnhsb20_rp22sh2s8i66p75cjge8or6clh2bs)
---
Now that the nation has gotten another chance to see what we're fighting for, here's what they know:
* We **WILL** put an end to the absurd claim that men can get pregnant.
* We **WILL** throw every piece of sexually-explicit material they've tried to shove into our nation's elementary schools in the garbage--where it belongs.
* We **WILL** go straight to the southern border, ARMED, and leave Mexican drug cartel members trying to bring thousands of pounds of fentanyl near young Americans STONE COLD DEAD.
* We **WILL** fire every bureaucrat that is siphoning off tax-payer dollars to fund ineffective, corrupt, useless agencies.

* We **WILL** hold federal leaders accountable for the harm they've done to adult Americans and the futures of American children.
* We **WILL** restore our American dominance and strength from our military, to our manufacturing, and to our energy sector.
* We **WILL** END our toxic, abusive relationship with China, and declare our economic independence from foreign adversaries.

After last night's debate, we are one step closer to slashing the outrageous cost of living that Biden has imposed on average Americans, stripping the woke absurdity out of the lives of children, and reinstating our dominance as a nation so our future is as proud, independent, and free as our past.

**[<< Help me continue to fight back by rushing in any amount you can to my campaign here >>](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zbpuqv9rn7s3362vau8bqn602arcn180fc0fhr6o_rp22sh2s8i66p75cjge8or6clh2bs)**

We're doing everything we can to defeat this failing radical Left for good, but they've seen how strong we are and what we will achieve, and now we have a giant target on our back. It will take even more--we MUST NOT let up.

**Let 's not beat around the bush: last night's victory will be short lived if we don't finish this quarter on top.** **[Can my team and I count on your support before Saturday?](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z4a1104ma04j1rvbac73g11g6nvm9thm9knb06tg_rp22sh2s8i66p75cjge8or6clh2bs "Can my team and I count on your support before Saturday?")**

Ron DeSantis

_**Get to Know Ron DeSantis**_
---
| | | [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zjds2alplme2ecirvmvpm420jo8d3js9tv1muvl8_rp22sh2s8i66p75cjge8or6clh2bs)
---
Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is _personal_ and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.
---

---
On Day One, Ron DeSantis has _promised_ that he will bring a RECKONING for what unelected bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to children. Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by _immediately getting to work_ stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late. In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He's taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and **_won every single time_**. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon. _That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now._

Friend, There is no clearer contrast between Joe Biden and the energy we brought to the stage last night at the second Republican debate. We just gave the nation a preview of what the nation will see in the 2024 general election, and the response we're getting now is unbelievable. Now is the time to take action. We put in the work standing up to the challengers last night, but we are just getting started. We are facing a chance to maximize our momentum TODAY if we step up and make this victory a steppingstone to the next stage of our campaign, **[but that means coming together to earn an unprecedented show of support for our mission.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zh3a6671qmeqbrhmsfdgq542cdjor5vlqchb58s8_rp22sh2s8i66p75cjge8or6clh2bs "but that means coming together to earn an unprecedented show of support for our mission.")**

Now that the nation has gotten another chance to see what we're fighting for, here's what they know:
* We **WILL** put an end to the absurd claim that men can get pregnant.
* We **WILL** throw every piece of sexually-explicit material they've tried to shove into our nation's elementary schools in the garbage--where it belongs.
* We **WILL** go straight to the southern border, ARMED, and leave Mexican drug cartel members trying to bring thousands of pounds of fentanyl near young Americans STONE COLD DEAD.
* We **WILL** fire every bureaucrat that is siphoning off tax-payer dollars to fund ineffective, corrupt, useless agencies.

* We **WILL** hold federal leaders accountable for the harm they've done to adult Americans and the futures of American children.
* We **WILL** restore our American dominance and strength from our military, to our manufacturing, and to our energy sector.
* We **WILL** END our toxic, abusive relationship with China, and declare our economic independence from foreign adversaries.

After last night's debate, we are one step closer to slashing the outrageous cost of living that Biden has imposed on average Americans, stripping the woke absurdity out of the lives of children, and reinstating our dominance as a nation so our future is as proud, independent, and free as our past.

In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He's taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and **_won every single time_**. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon. _That's why he's running for President of the United States. Then I retired from my career of service... _Or so I thought. _ Recently, I announced my candidacy for the U.S. Senate in Michigan. **[It’ll be tough to win in Michigan-- but it’s possible with your support. ](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c678298%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=b4fM76JgnqtOu0W56rFlwg&sysid=1)** I’m not running to make money. Friend,

Our border is a disaster.

Every day, tens of thousands of immigrants cross the border. Joe Biden and the Democrats want this to happen. They support open borders. In fact, they tear down barriers that Texas puts up!

Now, you’d think Republicans would be against open borders.

You’d think a Republican whose district shares the largest border with Mexico would be against open borders.

_**WRONG.**_

Republican Tony Gonzales sides with Biden on amnesty. He killed conservative Chip Roy’s border security bill. Gonzales wants to tie any border security to amnesty.

_Tony has got to go._

name: Heidi Ganahl
subject: How to Actually Clean Up Our Voter Rolls
body:
Episode #19 of Unleashed with Heidi Ganahl is LIVE!
[](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-ajhkrdk-tkwdjuidt-r/) Hi Peter, It's been a minute since I popped into your inbox and released a new episode of Unleashed! We've been busy in the Ganahl household with back-to-school, lots of kid activities, some new projects I'm working on, and of course, CU football...

Meanwhile, I've been posting some great bonus episodes and just released a juicy new episode all about the validity of our elections. Let's catch you up:1️⃣ **BONUS EPISODE: Relationship Education OVER Sex-Ed with Joneen Mackenzie from My Relationship Center -- **_Joneen Mackenzie has joined forces with the University of Denver and Harvard 's Human Flourishing Project to create a kid-informed, evidence-based, activity-based, and heart-based curriculum around relationships with the intention to replace sex education with relationship education. [LISTEN](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-ajhkrdk-tkwdjuidt-y/) or watch on [YOUTUBE](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-ajhkrdk-tkwdjuidt-j/) or [RUMBLE](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-ajhkrdk-tkwdjuidt-t/)._2️⃣ **BONUS EPISODE: Legislative Session Review with State Senator Rod Pelton and State Representative Ty Winter -- **_Rod and Ty give us insights on this year's General Assembly, including their favorite and least favorite bills that passed, what legislation we should be prepared for (Proposition HH being a big one coming up this November), and what it 's tactically like being the minority. [LISTEN](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-ajhkrdk-tkwdjuidt-i/) or watch on [YOUTUBE](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-ajhkrdk-tkwdjuidt-d/) or [RUMBLE](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-ajhkrdk-tkwdjuidt-h/)._3️⃣ **BONUS EPISODE: Turning Faith Into Action with Lance Williams from TPUSA Faith --_ _**_Lance combines his love for ministry and government by working with churches to help educate, equip, mobilize, and engage their congregations about politics and stand up for truth in the public square. Heidi and Lance discuss tactical ways to turn faith into inspired civic action and why it 's so important for people of faith to vote their values at the ballot boxes. [LISTEN](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-ajhkrdk-tkwdjuidt-k/) or watch on [YOUTUBE](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-ajhkrdk-tkwdjuidt-b/) or [RUMBLE](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-ajhkrdk-tkwdjuidt-n/)._

And on this week's NEW episode... Marly is leading an effort to ensure election validity (not just integrity) based on their audit of the New York 2022 election results, ultimately aiming to ensure valid elections before the 2024 election cycle. Marly discusses the four critical areas they've investigated: the accuracy of voter rolls, whether votes were counted from eligible voters, if the number of votes counted matches the number of voters who voted, and the error rate allowed for federal elections.
### **Episode #19 - ELECTION VALIDITY:
HOW TO ACTUALLY CLEAN UP OUR VOTER ROLLS**
[](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-ajhkrdk-tkwdjuidt-p/) [WATCH ON YOUTUBE](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-ajhkrdk-tkwdjuidt-x/) [WATCH ON RUMBLE](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-ajhkrdk-tkwdjuidt-m/) [LISTEN HERE](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-ajhkrdk-tkwdjuidt-c/) [READ HERE](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-ajhkrdk-tkwdjuidt-q/) _Not into podcasts? I post transcripts of my monologues and full episode breakdowns every week on my Substack.[You can subscribe here!](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-ajhkrdk-tkwdjuidt-a/)_ We've got more info on elections coming next week... Stay tuned! Heidi [](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-ajhkrdk-tkwdjuidt-f/)[](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-ajhkrdk-tkwdjuidt-z/)[](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-ajhkrdk-tkwdjuidt-v/)[](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-ajhkrdk-tkwdjuidt-e/)[](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-ajhkrdk-tkwdjuidt-s/)[](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-ajhkrdk-tkwdjuidt-g/) | Heidi GanahlLone Tree, CO [Preferences](https://heidi4gov.updatemyprofile.com/i-ajhkrdk-66AAC70D-tkwdjuidt-w) | [Unsubscribe](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-u-ajhkrdk-tkwdjuidt-yd/)

subject: Now they know what it looks like to win.

body:
The second Republican debate went just as well as we knew it would. We faced the nation, rose to the occasion, and won.

---
| | | | | | | | | | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23401%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=gPx%2bPeenZOz4mJJPOxqDnA&sysid=1)
---
Friend, There is no clearer contrast between Joe Biden and the energy we brought to the stage last night at the second Republican debate. We just gave the nation a preview of what the nation will see in the 2024 general election, and the response we’re getting now is unbelievable. Now is the time to take action. We put in the work standing up to the challengers last night, but we are just getting started. We are facing a chance to maximize our momentum TODAY if we step up and make this victory a steppingstone to the next stage of our campaign, **[but that means coming together to earn an unprecedented show of support for our mission.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23402%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=cNkdh3rCUS3tAEZsixzTkQ&sysid=1 "but that means coming
together to earn an unprecedented show of support for our mission.")**
---
| | [SUPPORT THE CAMPAIGN NOW: DONATE $25 HERE](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23403%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=jf6uhEvJ7oavFQudAlECLA&sysid=1)
---
Now that the nation has gotten another chance to see what we’re fighting for, here’s what they know:
* We **WILL** put an end to the absurd claim that men can get pregnant.
* We **WILL** throw every piece of sexually-explicit material they’ve tried to shove into our nation’s elementary schools in the garbage--where it belongs.
* We **WILL** go straight to the southern border, ARMED, and leave Mexican drug cartel members trying to bring thousands of pounds of fentanyl near young Americans STONE COLD DEAD.
* We **WILL** fire every bureaucrat that is siphoning off tax-payer dollars to fund ineffective, corrupt, useless agencies.

* We **WILL** hold federal leaders accountable for the harm they’ve done to adult Americans and the futures of American children.
* We **WILL** restore our American dominance and strength from our military, to our manufacturing, and to our energy sector.
* We **WILL** END our toxic, abusive relationship with China, and declare our economic independence from foreign adversaries.

After last night‘s debate, we are one step closer to slashing the outrageous cost of living that Biden has imposed on average Americans, stripping the woke absurdity out of the lives of children, and reinstating our dominance as a nation so our future is as proud, independent, and free as our past.

**[<< Help me continue to fight back by rushing in any amount you can to my campaign here >>](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23404%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=cyibvNTMTUjX6c6bDsjb3g&sysid=1)**

We’re doing everything we can to defeat this failing radical Left for good, but they’ve seen how strong we are and what we will achieve, and now we have a giant target on our back. It will take even more--we MUST NOT let up.

**Let’s not beat around the bush: last night’s victory will be short lived if we don’t finish this quarter on top.** **[Can my team and I count on your support before Saturday?](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23415%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Ruh0%2bk4GUTbM4Ld%2fuxBYKA&sysid=1 "Can my team and I count on
your support before Saturday?")**
---
| | [STAND UP TO WIN >> SEND IN $47](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23416%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=c4gmSlAtM7p63Jz%2fEDOmMA&sysid=1)
---
| | [RUSH IN ANY AMOUNT](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23417%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=lDIlgMdO5n0tURv1c4c%2bUw&sysid=1)
---
We have a long road ahead and these stakes are too high to risk falling behind. I need you to step up on this team, and I believe that you will. **[Click here to send in a quick donation to help fund our fight for a free American future.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23418%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Q7AnPaf51pApBB2dlRyJWw&sysid=1) ** In Freedom,

| [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23401%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=gPx%2bPeenZOz4mJJPOxqDnA&sysid=1)
---
Ron DeSantis

---
| | |
_**Get to Know Ron DeSantis**_
---
| | | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23401%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=gPx%2bPeenZOz4mJJPOxqDnA&sysid=1)
---
Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is _personal_ and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.
---
| [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23401%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=gPx%2bPeenZOz4mJJPOxqDnA&sysid=1)
---
On Day One, Ron DeSantis has _promised_ that he will bring a RECKONING for what unelected bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to children. Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by _immediately getting to work_ stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late. In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He’s taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and **_won every single time_**. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon. _That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now._

---

Dear Friend,

I hope you saw my announcement on Sean Hannity’s show that I’ve partnered with the Leadership Institute to launch the Riley Gaines Center.

I’m the 12-time All-American swimmer who speaks out against transgender ideology and fights to defend basic truths – that men are men and women are women.

The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute is now the exclusive headquarters of my work to lead conservatives of all types – patriots who will not be silenced by the weight of the left’s cultural pressure and who want to learn how to defend America’s freedoms.

When the left tries to shout you down profanely, when they viciously attack you – that’s when you know you’re saying the right things.

For those who are attacked, vilified, and persecuted for their support of America’s founding principles and traditional American values, the Riley Gaines Center sends a message that they are not alone – because I will stand bravely with them.

To train as many young people as I can to stand up for conservative principles, I must have the help of strong Leadership Institute supporters like you.

**[Will you help turn young men and women into Leaders for America?](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.com/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiMTI2MDY0NDI4MiIsInJxIjoiMDItYjIzMjcyLTVmNDM2M2MxMDM4NDRkNjk4ZThiOGYzODU0YTZmZmY3IiwicGgiOm51bGwsIm0iOmZhbHNlLCJ1aSI6IjIiLCJ1biI6IiIsInUiOiJodHRwczovL3NlY3VyZWQubGVhZGVyc2hpcGluc3RpdHV0ZS5vcmcvcmdjLTA4MjQyNC8_dXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXJpbGV5X2FwcGVhbCZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9djItQUVfRkZPNDMxODQifQ/h4TG92beLP3VqjdEyZyPTQ)**

The Riley Gaines Center is the exclusive home of my work to lead this crucial cause through:

* Speaking events and media appearances to rally everyday Americans to defend women’s identity and uphold vital truths.

* A coalition of women, student athletes, parents, and those who have been harmed by radical transgender ideology, to join me in speaking out across the country.

* A fast-growing team of speakers and grassroots organizers, who will help turn those ready to defend freedom into champions who put their principles into action.

---
Through the Riley Gaines Center, my fellow Leadership Institute colleagues and I will identify, recruit, train, mentor, and empower students, athletes, and parents across the country to become campus, community, and national Leaders for America.

Not only will these young leaders help our country right now. They will stand up for our principles for decades to come.

**[By joining me and the Leadership Institute team with your contribution to this new effort, you make a powerful difference for conservatives across the country, from college campuses to the halls of power.](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.com/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiMTI2MDY0NDI4MiIsInJxIjoiMDItYjIzMjcyLTVmNDM2M2MxMDM4NDRkNjk4ZThiOGYzODU0YTZmZmY3IiwicGgiOm51bGwsIm0iOmZhbHNlLCJ1aSI6IjMiLCJ1biI6IiIsInUiOiJodHRwczovL3NlY3VyZWQubGVhZGVyc2hpcGluc3RpdHV0ZS5vcmcvcmdjLTA4MjQyNC8_dXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXJpbGV5X2FwcGVhbCZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9djItQUVfRkZPNDMxODQifQ/tT9DMvSGh6IVMr9ea2MTJg)**

Thank you for your support and dedication to preserving commonsense truths and conservative principles in our country.

Stand bravely with me,

Riley Gaines
The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute

Friends, America was the premier power of the world. Our leaders were respected. Our military was feared. Our nation's institutions were trusted. **But today, under the Biden regime, our enemies sense weakness. They smell blood in the water, Friends. ** _You see, I thought I was done with politics ..._ I started my career of service by putting on a uniform in the United States Army. Then I took my service to the city of Chicago taking on organized crime as a special agent with the FBI. And I served over a decade in Congress leading the charge against some of the greatest threats in the world as Chairman of the U.S. House Intelligence Committee. Then I retired from my career of service... _Or so I thought. _ Recently, I announced my candidacy for the U.S. Senate in Michigan. **[It'll be tough to win in Michigan -- but it's possible with your support. ](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=631d2feb785d46c085cacc37a834ce08&_e=WZ7dqj4RJ2l0-9YIf2O8Hl23t9HJo94u1nHDt4_jm9IVRwyZSPJ_d25UPEIIS0TRsqC8AlnBA6tHJpHddjQ4nCJ-zpJO-ehn8wsZ2bjK_j06AChEcGf42e7G3QyHJg6PQ2r7OXIfjwVwkjKQG1NKTUp-cG4PLF8HmN8idWjdrUv4OVeq0rXVYe7TJ7p0qOqu2W6aV4Xt8fDBOz26XvSvnK-NzoDaZ4xq40LlvGoqlj6tApqLPTLcGd5hlWdyy42jlEuNQKUXbgJxFnj28IPPsB0f94EcbbIf6XNQsDsC1OnQdgNFrPRLTJetsxOot_lNe1Y9ATLZb1E36dJl0v6pOyNNooNm6NdGs5YYo93S5_isOFmS8gvm-kJvCQCj5zTXZDl74xygBIDv7BJxxcIqh8unUoncOYkyMN0ItjrvieMeJHVY4vs3mcpfyEoaFjvW)** I'm not running to make money. I'm not running because, like many in Washington, it's the only thing I know how to do.

| Peter,
---
The Constitution is the greatest legal document of the modern world, enshrining the promise of liberty and equality for all by securing our individual rights against the prospect of a tyrannical government.
As our Founding Fathers feared, there are those who rose to power without the belief in our system, and are driven only by the desire to loot our nation's taxpayers blind. NO MORE!
It's high time that "We the People" remind the failed leaders up in D.C. that we have the right to express ourselves, the right to keep and bear arms, and the absolute right to call out government officials who are actively engaging in corrupt buyouts and bribery!
I have made it my goal during my public service life to create a more transparent government that is subservient to the people, not the other way around. And I have continued to champion our rights in this election as well!
In just 24 hours, my end-of-quarter fundraising deadline will be here, and I'd like to show just how much Nevadans are determined to send in a Conservative leader who will not engage in political theater while the Rule of Law is ignored!

Can you chip in $22 to prevent another $2,200 tax increase?
| | |
---
|
---
| Dear Neighbor,

Everyone knows the last four years have resulted in an average residential tax increase of $2,200 for Prince William County families (this, in addition to the increased taxes on your meals and personal property).

This didn't have to be the case. With record revenue, and personal economic fallout from shutdowns and inflation, I have proposed significantly reduced or flat tax bills for our homeowners each and every year I've been on the Board.

With your help, I will do the same over the next four years. And with a citizen-friendly majority, we will actually make it happen.

I know you've been socked enough by your local government the last four years. I'll never try to take $2,200 more out of your pocket in such a short amount of time - or any length of time.

But if you have the means left over, I'm going to ask you to consider chipping in a smaller amount.

[Will you consider $22 today to help us stop another $2,200 (or more) increase to your residential tax bills in the next four years](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001xFNss_NGshW51IHuuqIZX_uDMn5DtZbk88AMrC5iL3HVJYRdOU0PMMqoFQwHrauRAPdWkuk79UzQnqgD6_phUCKFXHr78dAXHpqZ1tV4E1HbynjO8WcaqMLVNpuw5RiXFDqipZeD9ldIKvNBoL2-TpDQDurxQ2tKNu1kbJ97iHb3lm9OLEDtDwJ2uCtyjyY6&c=bzMwTmkuzJD-66aXeH-y0Wptdegc7V5VUPk99lTz70ItOAyjszOrvQ==&ch=XJF5DChtqlSC3ODPhVblp_-QZuhPCL_ganPOtBW8yTcL8EhnRTLdBw==)?

If the trifecta of tax increases (home/residential, meals, vehicles/property) levied on you by the Board majority over the last four years have taught us anything, it's that no amount of inflation or economic hardship will soften the hearts of the current ruling class in Prince William County as it relates to your pocketbook.

[Your help today (at $22 or whatever amount you can afford)](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001xFNss_NGshW51IHuuqIZX_uDMn5DtZbk88AMrC5iL3HVJYRdOU0PMMqoFQwHrauRAPdWkuk79UzQnqgD6_phUCKFXHr78dAXHpqZ1tV4E1HbynjO8WcaqMLVNpuw5RiXFDqipZeD9ldIKvNBoL2-TpDQDurxQ2tKNu1kbJ97iHb3lm9OLEDtDwJ2uCtyjyY6&c=bzMwTmkuzJD-66aXeH-y0Wptdegc7V5VUPk99lTz70ItOAyjszOrvQ==&ch=XJF5DChtqlSC3ODPhVblp_-QZuhPCL_ganPOtBW8yTcL8EhnRTLdBw==) will enable a new citizen-first majority to do just that - place you, the citizen, first in Prince William County, once again.

I understand what it takes to try to make ends-meet. I grew up in a very working-class family and today am right about in the middle of the middle class.

As challenging as times have been, your government shouldn't be making life harder or more expensive on you. I'm not asking for $2,200. [But $22 will go a long way towards restoring fiscal sanity in Prince William County and a government, of, by, and for the people of our great county](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001xFNss_NGshW51IHuuqIZX_uDMn5DtZbk88AMrC5iL3HVJYRdOU0PMMqoFQwHrauRAPdWkuk79UzQnqgD6_phUCKFXHr78dAXHpqZ1tV4E1HbynjO8WcaqMLVNpuw5RiXFDqipZeD9ldIKvNBoL2-TpDQDurxQ2tKNu1kbJ97iHb3lm9OLEDtDwJ2uCtyjyY6&c=bzMwTmkuzJD-66aXeH-y0Wptdegc7V5VUPk99lTz70ItOAyjszOrvQ==&ch=XJF5DChtqlSC3ODPhVblp_-QZuhPCL_ganPOtBW8yTcL8EhnRTLdBw==).

Thank you so much for your consideration and God Bless.

For Prince William,

Yesli Vega
Prince William County Supervisor
Coles District Servant

name: Tim Holbert, American Veterans Center
subject: Help me teach our children the bravery of WWII veterans
body:
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.

%Fellow American, Our schools used to teach every child about D-Day. Among the thousands of heroes of the longest day were the 12 soldiers who received the Medal of Honor for their courage and valor... but that's no longer the case. WAs our Greatest Generation has passed, we have failed to teach our children the legacy of service, honor, and sacrifice of the men who fought their way into Hitler's Fortress Europe. In a recent poll of High School Seniors:
* 72% Didn't know we fought Hitler during World War II.
* 87% Didn't know we entered WWII because of the attacks on Pearl Harbor.
* 60% Didn't know which countries we fought in WWII
* 13% Thought General Dwight Eisenhower was a general from the Civil War

%Fellow American, American kids are not being taught our nation's history. According to 'The Nation's Report Card,' America's high schoolers' proficiency in U.S. History and Civics is at its lowest level in nearly 30 years. They know little of the immense courage our troops displayed fighting for their freedoms in the Second World War, and they know little of the heroes who gave their life in service to our country. In fact, most Americans these days know next to nothing about World War II and the millions of young soldiers who put their lives on the line to serve their country in the war, let alone in Korea or Vietnam. To help educate young Americans about the selfless, patriotic, and courageous heroes in WWII, the American Veterans Center created a limited-edition booklet - **_A Mighty Endeavor: Operation Overlord through the Eyes of D-Day's Greatest Heroes._** [**For the next 24 hours, I'm holding a copy of this brand new, one-of-a-kind booklet for you, %Fellow American. With your gift of any amount today, a copy of _A Mighty Endeavor_ will be yours to share with family and friends.**](http://trk.readactnews._pa76-s1N9g)
---
[Claim your copy of **_A Mighty Endeavor_**](http://trk.readactnews.)
---
[](http://trk.readactnews._Iw)
---
Every one of the 156,000 men who stormed the beaches of Normandy on that bloodyday is a hero in my book. It took real guts to run head-first into a hailstorm of bullets and mortar rounds. We all hope nobody ever needs to experience something like it again. But it is essential we remember, and learn. The AVC is devoted to preserving their history, so that today's young Americans - and those in generations to come - can learn from the heroes you and I grew up idolizing. The 12 heroes who received the Medal of Honor showed so much courage and valor in the invasion of Normandy, that they were individually chosen to receive our nation's highest honor. All Americans should read the stories and know of these heroes who have been all but forgotten. The [**American Veterans Center is committed to bringing the legacy of the greatest generation to the latest generation, and with your gift today, we can preserve the legacy of America's World War II veterans.**](http://trk.readactnews.) As a token of my thanks for your support, I'll send you a limited-edition copy of **_A Mighty Endeavor_**. When you receive it, I have just one request; please share it with a loved one. Show them these stories and talk about how important their legacy is to our history. But, please let me know in the next 24 hours if you're claiming your copy! It is my hope that you'll share this booklet with your children, grandchildren, and neighbors and tell them all about D-Day.
---

---
%Fellow American, we must share the TRUTH about American WWII veterans with America's youth - we cannot fail them any longer. We must educate our nation's children with messages of the D-Day heroes who were up against a battle-hardened enemy, whose very actions preserved the freedoms we enjoy today. [**Please support American Veterans Center's mission to fight the historical ignorance plaguing today's culture and teach America's young people what real service meant during WWII.**](http://trk.readactnews.) Whether you can afford to donate $15, $35, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000, or any other amount - I'll send along your copy of **_A Mighty Endeavor: Operation Overlord through the Eyes of D-Day's Greatest Heroes_** as a "thank you" for your support of our bravest Americans. Thank you and God bless,

| Meet **Mark Walker**

Congressman Mark Walker started his career in finance and, after earning his theology degree, Walker served 16 years as a pastor. In 2014, Walker stepped away from ministry and made a successful run for the U.S. Congress defeating a host of elected politicians. In 2015, Congressman Walker became the first member in an inaugural term to be elected Chair of the Republican Study Committee (RSC) - the largest caucus in Congress with 160 members and a position previously held by Vice President Pence and Congressman Jim Jordan.

In 2018, Walker was elected as Vice Chair of the entire conference, becoming the highest rated conservative to serve in the top four leadership positions in Congress. Walker is also the last member of Congress to secure a floor vote on a balanced budget amendment and led the House on HBCU initiatives winning the United Negro College Fund President’s list award. Congressman Walker served on multiple committees and in 2019, Walker was appointed to ranking member on the Committee on Homeland Security’s Intelligence and Counter-Terrorism’s subcommittee. Walker was co-chair of the bicameral prayer caucus for five years and also won the GOP MVP award as the starting pitcher on the Republican baseball team for the annual charity game.

Congressman Walker was redistricted out of his seat and stepped away from Congress in 2021. Walker ran for U.S. Senate in 2022 and was endorsed by Senators Tim Scott and James Lankford, Gov. Mike Huckabee, Hall of Fame Coach Tony Dungy and more than 200 pastors across North Carolina. Walker is currently the president of a political consulting business called Advancing Hope USA, and advocated for the two North Carolina Supreme Court candidates and 4 North Carolina Court of Appeals candidates through his independent expenditure organization, Win the Courts during this past general election. Congressman Walker and his wife Kelly, a Family Nurse Practitioner and flight trauma specialist, have been married for thirty years and have three children.

| | | You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[ unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tfc8e28f4-d206-44b3-9fd5-4750592b1447/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _._

That day, Jen, Jesse, and I lost a piece of our hearts that no amount of time, thoughts, or prayers will ever heal.

I was devastated. And enraged. I knew that I had to do something. No family should have to endure the loss that mine did but, unfortunately, far too many have and will.

**The truth is, the only way we’re going to prevent future mass shootings and save lives is by electing a historic wave of gun violence prevention candidates to office who will have the courage to enact common sense gun reforms.**

[**_That’s why I’m humbly asking if you’ll join Blue Amp Action and me in electing one of those leaders: Dr. Brian Williams. Brian is a first-time candidate and trauma surgeon who treats victims of gun violence who needs your help to reach this critical FEC goal before the end of the month so he can win an open seat in Congress._**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T36c6f4e7-7ceb-4cd9-9b6a-97fc5ce14d03/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| In the aftermath of the Parkland mass shooting, it immediately became clear that the politicians and institutions my community had trusted to protect us had failed us miserably. For the extremist state legislators and federal lawmakers supposedly “representing” us in Congress, our children’s lives had a price.

But through that anger and despair, I found a sense of hope.

**I remain hopeful because of the great people I have had the good fortune of meeting over the years who are dedicated to saving lives from senseless gun violence. Dr. Brian Williams is one of them.**

He never thought he would run for office – but after responding to a mass shooting in Dallas, he knew there was work to do beyond the operating room. He then advised Congress on what would become **the first major Federal gun reform bill signed into law in thirty years and is now running for an open House seat in Texas.**

He’s a person who is putting himself out there because of what he has seen and he’s exactly the kind of leader we need representing and fighting for us in Congress. Dr. Brian Williams has been a fearless leader on this issue and will be in Congress.

[**_For all the families who have lost someone to gun violence and for all those families who will soon experience this devastation without life-saving reforms, I’m asking if you’ll join me in electing Dr. Brian Williams and a wave of gun violence prevention champions like him at all levels of government._**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tedf079f8-3074-4113-a108-16bd7e353a79/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can . | | | | | | | | Peter – It’s always hard to say these words: On February 14, 2018, my beloved daughter Jaime was killed in her own high school in Parkland, Florida, at the hands of a mass shooter who never should have had access to a gun. That day, Jen, Jesse, and I lost a piece of our hearts that no amount of time, thoughts, or prayers will ever heal. I was devastated. And enraged. I knew that I had to do something. No family should have to endure the loss that mine did but, unfortunately, far too many have and will. The truth is, the only way we’re going to prevent future mass shootings and save lives is by electing a historic wave of gun violence prevention candidates to office who will have the courage to enact common sense gun reforms. | | | | | | | | In the aftermath of the Parkland mass shooting, it immediately became clear that the politicians and institutions my community had trusted to protect us had failed us miserably. For the extremist state legislators and federal lawmakers supposedly “representing” us in Congress, our children’s lives had a price. But through that anger and despair, I found a sense of hope. I remain hopeful because of the great people I have had the good fortune of meeting over the years who are dedicated to saving lives from senseless gun violence. Dr. Brian Williams is one of them. He never thought he would run for office – but after responding to a mass shooting in Dallas, he knew there was work to do beyond the operating room. He then advised Congress on what would become the first major Federal gun reform bill signed into law in thirty years and is now running for an open House seat in Texas. He’s a person who is putting himself out there because of what he has seen and he’s exactly the kind of leader we need representing and fighting for us in Congress. Dear Friends,

Join us this coming Tuesday, Oct. 3, at Great American Ranch in Midlothian, to hear the latest regarding Election Integrity efforts in Virginia from guest speakers Darrel Bow and Roxanna Gray.
Guest Speaker Darrel Bow
-Served in the United States Marine Corps on active duty from 1984 to 1992.
-Joined the Kentucky Army National Guard from 1992 to 1995 to work in counter narcotics with the federal state and local agencies.
-Served in the U.S. Marine Corps Reserves from 1995 to 1997 as the Platoon Sergeant and acting Platoon Commander.
-In 2000, joined the U.S. Secret Service and worked for about two years in Washington DC, protecting the President and Vice President and their families. Enforcing local and federal laws in Washington DC.
-After 9-11 terror attacks, transferred to the Federal Air Marshal Service working in counter terror operations for 19 and half years working from the Washington Field office traveling all around the world and across the country, holding a Top Secret Clearance in Department Homeland Security and retired in December 2021.
-He has devoted the last several years investigating election results and served as an expert witness on Election Integrity bills presented before the Virginia Senate Privileges and Elections Committee.

Guest Speaker Roxanna Gray
-Roxanna Gray and other grassroots individuals are diligently working on cleaning the registered voter list.
-In addition to cleaning up the inactive voter lists, Roxanna is volunteering with some political parties to clean the registered voter list one house at a time.

We need more help to maintain an accurate registered voter list. The analysis in Holtzman Vogel's pre-litigation notice to ELECT (see attachment) shows that Virginia's registered voter list is not as accurate as it should be. EPEC, Electoral Process Education Corporation, also compared the registered voters to the U.S. Census and came up with similar results.

As of Sept. 1, 2023 Virginia had 499,960 inactive registered voters (8% of the registered voter list). On July 1, 2023, inactive was 423,518 but a change of address at the end of July increased it. Inactive voters are potential voters who have moved. They are technically active because they can still vote. Lots have moved out of state.

EPEC has identified more than 90,000 voter registrations in the Commonwealth of Virginia that may be duplicates, or questionable clones (see attachment). That could mean that thousands of voters may be assigned more than one voter identification number. A potential "cloned" record is defined as a record in the VA Registered Voter List (RVL) where the Full Name (First + Middle + Last + Suffix) and full Date of Birth matches another record, but they have different voter identification numbers.

We also need to focus on the laws, policies and procedures that need to be changed to keep an accurate registered voter list. Letters have been sent to the AG, Governor and the Commissioner of Elections regarding the inaccuracy of Virginia Voter Registration Lists & Non-Citizens on Virginia's voter registration list.

We need to hold our elected officials accountable and make them take action to secure our elections.

This can be done from your own home. Many active registered voters have moved and need to be cancelled or address updated on the registered voter list.

We hope to see this coming Tuesday.

For God & Country,
Amanda Chase

As of Sept. 1, 2023 Virginia had 499,960 inactive registered voters (8% of the registered voter list). On July 1, 2023, inactive was 423,518 but a change of address at the end of July increased it. Inactive voters are potential voters who have moved. They are technically active because they can still vote. Lots have moved out of state. EPEC has identified more than 90,000 voter registrations in the Commonwealth of Virginia that may be duplicates, or questionable clones (see attachment). That could mean that thousands of voters may be assigned more than one voter identification number. A potential "cloned" record is defined as a record in the VA Registered Voter List (RVL) where the Full Name (First + Middle + Last + Suffix) and full Date of Birth matches another record, but they have different voter identification numbers. We also need to focus on the laws, policies and procedures that need to be changed to keep an accurate registered voter list. Letters have been sent to the AG, Governor and the Commissioner of Elections regarding the inaccuracy of Virginia Voter Registration Lists & Non-Citizens on Virginia's voter registration list. We need to hold our elected officials accountable and make them take action to secure our elections. This can be done from your own home. Many active registered voters have moved and need to be cancelled or address updated on the registered voter list. We hope to see this coming Tuesday. | Friends,
For the last decade, the team at Shift WA has exposed the hypocrisy about Governor Jay Inslee's global traveling escapades, including attending climate change conferences in Finland, Scotland, and France. Rather than pursue other, less carbon-intensive options for sharing his voice at such meetings of the global elite, our "green" governor took many opportunities for lavish travel on the taxpayer's dime. Most recently, we pointed out how our "green" governor traveled - with his wife - to the United Nations to deliver a four-minute speech on climate change. Apparently, soon-to-be-ex-Governor Inslee is so committed to the climate change agenda that he willingly emitted 5,400 pounds of CO2 to give a four-minute speech that he could have delivered via Zoom. Of course, Inslee's lavish, taxpayer-funded trip to the Big Apple wasn't really about climate change. He's on the hunt for his next job! **Thankfully, Inslee won't be seeking re-election, but that won't stop him from using your hard-earned taxpayer dollars for his personal job search.** To shed a humorous light on Inslee's search for his next endeavors we've taken the liberty of creating a resume that outlines his biggest environmental "achievements." It's time to expose Inslee's true motives and hold him accountable for his actions. **_[Help us spread the word and share Inslee's resume far and wide by making a contribution today.](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62307239:WFJ9FjiNd:m:1:2610672541:5056D1DD8FE6377DEC33EDF3F29F8B03:r)_** Together, we can ensure that Inslee's hypocrisy and self-serving agenda do not go unnoticed. **_[Please consider making an end-of-month donation of $100, $50, or $25.](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62307239:WFJ9FjiNd:m:1:2610672541:5056D1DD8FE6377DEC33EDF3F29F8B03:r)_** Thank you, The Shift WA team P.S. Friend,

I
took the stage at the second Republican presidential primary
debate on September 27th to fight tooth and nail for our country,
our freedom, our future, and your children because I know one
thing to be true: America is suffering, and it's up to US to
change course.

I
have good news: we're one step closer to defeating Joe Biden and
dismantling the woke indoctrination that's run rampant across
this country after we dominated on the debate stage. No excuses.
Once again, we got the job done. Now, it's time to kick up the
intensity of this campaign, and I need to make sure you know who
I am and who I'm fighting for so you can join me in this critical
race.

I'm
a blue-collar kid from Florida who worked to pay my way through
college and law school in the years leading up to 9/11. After
witnessing that horrific attack on the hard-earned freedom and
democracy of this country, I knew I had to put on the uniform and
serve my country, so I volunteered for the Navy and was deployed
to Iraq as a JAG Officer in support of SEAL Team 1.

After my time in the service, I returned to Florida, where I
continued the fight to defend the values I believe in as a
Congressman and now Governor of this free state. In Florida, I
met my incredible wife Casey at a driving range, got married in
2009, and have since been blessed with 3 young kids: Madison (6),
Mason (5), and Mamie (3). My family is the reason I will NEVER
back down from my fight to get the radical Left far away from our
rights as parents and the education of children. I refuse to put
up with the woke mob LYING to my kids about men getting pregnant.

I've watched Joe Biden try to indoctrinate children into
ridiculous notions of gender ideology and radical critical race
theory through public elementary schools. As a father to my three
young children, I will not accept this decline and neglect of our
next generation and I will put an end to it.

I
have plans to rip up every failing policy and get to work
reversing the decline of our country. On Day One as President, I
am pledging to usher in a RECKONING for what unelected
bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to
children. I will ignite our Great American Comeback by
immediately getting to work stopping the invasion across our
southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the
mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring
our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on
track before it's too late.

This is my vision for America. Help make it a
reality > CHIP IN $10

Governor of Florida, I've made it my mission to lead with
conviction, stand firm in the truth, and never back down from
fighting for the people I serve, especially when Covid-19 caused
commonsense to become an uncommon virtue across our country. We
refused to bend the knee to unelected bureaucrats who thought
they deserved the power to control American lives, and we
benefitted because of it.

Leadership matters. We've set the example in Florida. But if we
don't get our entire country back on track now, we risk letting
the Left lead our country down a deeper path of decline for four
more years. I believe we can come back from the harm they've
caused to our country so far, but we have to act.

Decline is a choice. Success is attainable. And freedom is worth
fighting for. But we can't win unless we come together and defeat
Joe Biden next November. I want you to know, friend: I am not
running to be President, I am running to get things done as
President.

Our
nation is facing a critical choice in 2024: Freedom or Decline.

I
made my case for the choice I need you to make with me on that
debate stage in California. I know that no one is entitled to
anything in this world, so I will continue to show up and take
this vision of our Great American Comeback directly to you, as a
Presidential candidate should.

I
will never back down from being your voice and your fighter.
Please, join me in fighting for the future-because freedom is
always worth fighting for.

In
Freedom,

Ron

body:
I know there are a number of organizations and campaigns in your inbox asking you for your support.
#
Derek, this is Paul Eaton.
I know you appreciate it when we get to the point.
And I know there are several organizations and campaigns in your inbox asking you for your support.
So, I am asking you to consider VoteVets. If you’re ready to make a contribution, you can use my link:
**[https://act.votevets.org/go/Eaton-EOQ](https://act.votevets.org/go/2927?c0=vv-pac-em-sept23.AXrwBB&refcode=em230929-1-15&t=1&akid=17298%2E3013755%2EIM1R28)**
As a retired General who was confirmed by the Senate, Tommy Tuberville’s hold on promotions for our most senior officers is something that strikes very close to home for me.
The reason the American warrior does the amazing things he or she does is trust. Trust in the chain of command and trust in America and her government. This Tuberville stunt is doing irreparable harm to that essential trust between our civilian and Military leaders.
That is why I am so proud of the work we have done to move these promotions forward. It is critical to our National Security, yes. But it is also critical to the fabric of our country and our Democracy.
We will not stop until we finish the fight. But to do that, we will need your help.
Support from people like you is critical. We haven’t convinced you to donate yet, but we’re hoping that today is the day you make your first donation. Do it ahead of our critical end-of-quarter FEC deadline.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=f22b3859a342a9e004c78ade214feb37f390afcf6c08c44f120faa339a755650d2d01b4a24ced1671f27f1bd94de7a0bbf10c51d1890fd7f

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain.

After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom.

When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor.

Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide.

In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is personal and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=e7c3f466b87a0ce24800319b89c33c7db99dcd3a08e12f8d8117503d5d6f5f2f384b8af3b59d021edf851ac9492fe57bb198c2cb2239eb5a

On Day One, Ron DeSantis has promised that he will bring a RECKONING for what unelected bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to children. Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by immediately getting to work stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late.

In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He’s taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and won every single time. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon.

That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now.

I’ll explain more, but first, I have to ask you to make your first grassroots donation before our critical deadline on Saturday.= Here’s the deal: Three days from now is our end-of-quarter fundraising deadline. Peter, The second GOP presidential debate was hosted Wednesday evening at the Reagan Library in California, and I believe it strengthened my argument about why I think Americans would be better served by a different format than these forums that are just filled with soundbite performances. ---
