The GOP has been adrift for years now, seemingly without any comprehensive plan, and I believe that the candidate who can articulate a common sense, conservative policy agenda and hopeful vision has a real chance to break through.

The Republican party appears to be in the grip of negative populism that it just can't shake. Republican leaders must learn to express their policy ideas in aspirational ways that bring courage and optimism to American families that are hurting and fearful. I spoke about this on Thursday:
---
[](http://links.johnkasich.com/u/click?_t=6a3b28686d0a4d77958e12349305a4fe&_m=7ea15fb5b4e64a13acc823bee45dfda2&_e=0-4tGeSbvD-4tHp_mbfy20iOYRTyEenbP8E-MqDFTMDptV8yY41jGIgtnV6MwxLndnPD9FcYQz0nBqD28wFxuKeuvQ9EEpR82okeuWlMpGXb7HQc0NtuBjUBd1kgy63zEw2tH5HrgwPxKmhNnWZj9yPA6br0qmQeqLPnnoeiNzokycPAiHytGIEAAsvxz0EDeLCrPEtPjLeSHtR4Wwh0Lm5CS8PzT8QViEnlZ8qpZbf3H-jRNeGhi6egnCFXzaCf)

When I ran for public office, the Republican party was my vehicle, but never my master. | | | | | Peter, it’s Ben Wikler — Chair of the Democratic Party of Wisconsin. I asked Blue Amp Action if I could reach out with another update: Republicans are still trying to use their gerrymandered majorities in the state legislature to impeach, convict, and remove Justice Janet Protasiewicz from the Wisconsin Supreme Court. But we're fighting back. Here’s what we’ve accomplished so far: ✅ We’ve talked to thousands of voters at their doors and over the phone about our Defend Justice campaign. ✅ Thousands of voters have used WisDems' call and email writing tools to contact their legislators. ✅ So far, one Republican has firmly committed to not impeach, convict, or remove Justice Janet Protasiewicz — and we know others who are slowly coming around. We’ve come a long way in the last few weeks, NAME. But we still need thousands of voters to contact their state legislators. If Republicans impeach and remove Justice Janet by December 1, 2023, this will trigger a Supreme Court Election next April — on the same day as the chaotic GOP presidential primary. [So I’m asking you to chip in a split $10 donation between WisDems and Blue Amp Action before our End of Quarter deadline to pressure Republicans to stop their attacks on Justice Protasiewicz >>](https://default.salsalabs.org/T621ba33e-3c89-4815-969a-704e7e7215bb/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) [DONATE $10 NOW!](https://default.salsalabs.org/T04d696c5-f76d-45ba-9588-afc4973a896e/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) The Defend Justice Campaign is a top-to-bottom effort to stop these unprecedented impeachment threats, and we can’t do it without your support.

name: David Horowitz
subject: Obama fast tracked it
body:
America is on the brink of destruction.

| |
---
| | Fellow Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don’t say this to shock or scare you – I say it because it’s true. _What we see today didn’t happen overnight. It’s the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making..._ **...and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast tracking their agenda.** I’d know better than most. When I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. 50 years ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited _Ramparts_ – radical Left's largest magazine. I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. My eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my “comrades” made possible. So I left and never looked back. I cast my 1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan – then I started the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left and I’ve dedicated the last 40 years to exposing them. Why? Because I knew first-hand the threat our country was facing. I knew what was at stake and I knew if I didn’t tell the American people what I knew, we would lose our country forever. That’s why I spent 6 months writing** _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_** – and I want you to have your very own copy of it. **[So I’m asking you to stand with me and make a generous, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to my Freedom Center. As a thank you, I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z6ti3lf6qq58kifb3fd30icvssb82onmpk4jr9ro_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1i6eor6clh2bs)** When you think of “the enemy within” you may think of Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi or even Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez...and you wouldn’t be wrong. But make no mistake: **The real mastermind is Barack Obama.** Barack Obama laid the groundwork for everything we’ve seen since 2020 back in 2008. Barack Obama led the destruction of our cities, cozying up to Black Lives Matter radicals and siding with criminals over police upholding the rule of law. Barack Obama championed the castration of our military, making us a laughingstock on the world stage. And Barack Obama was the true architect behind the bogus Russian collusion witch hunt. The devastation and destruction we see today has been over a decade in the making – but most of the American people have no clue what we’re up against. **That’s why I wrote _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_ to explain how communist and fascist Leftists infiltrated and overtook the Democrat Party...** ...how it has become a party of racism and hatred attacking the very foundations of our country... ... and how their ultimate goal is to create a one-party state – and cancel, deplatform and silence every last one of their political opponents by slandering them as “white supremacists” and worse. The reviews speak for themselves... “A Great Book” – Dinesh D’Souza “ _The Enemy Within_ is a book for all patriots who understand that our country is in a fight for its life.” – Mark Levin “David Horowitz does it again in a must-read for any American concerned about where we are headed as a nation.” Laura Ingraham I wrote _The Enemy Within_ because... I know if our country stands a chance, Americans must understand exactly how sinister and dangerous the new Democrat Party actually is. I was the enemy within — and I know in my bones what it will take to defeat them. We’ve reached the point in our history that will decide our future – and we either win these political battles or lose everything that makes us prosperous and free. **[That’s why I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within when you donate $35 or more to the Freedom Center today and give us the ammunition we need to expose the Left’s evil agenda to every American patriot.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zun76o2bsupkpl425ce5dkj62sl3qopabpmqfts0_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1i6eor6clh2bs)** The Left is at war with America. They don’t simply disagree with us about how to make our country better – they want to destroy it to make way for their Marxist dystopia. Or in Obama’s own words “radically transform” America. **And they don’t care how much they have to lie, cheat or steal to achieve it.** So it’s up to patriots like you and me to expose the truth about the Left to our fellow Americans while we still can.
---
| | Sincerely,

David Horowitz

body:
And why it matters to our movement.
# [](https://act.losecruzpac.com/go/128?t=1&akid=104%2E623276%2EMTtODq)
Today is Friday, which means we have a day left before our _first_ EOQ fundraising deadline.
But first, let’s explain what EOQ is and why it matters to our movement.
EOQ (or end-of-quarter) deadlines are important to the success of any grassroots campaign.
It provides an in-depth look into our fundraising capabilities — which in turn dictates our campaign strategy to Lose Cruz once and for all in 2024.
The goals our Finance Team set aren't arbitrary. Everything from our ability to run a hard-hitting ads campaign against Ted to reaching every single Texas voter depends on reaching this critical fundraising goal.
We knew taking on Ted Cruz was never going to be an easy task. But if our movement is going to be successful, it’s important that we begin to amass the resources necessary to not only take on Ted and the millions the GOP will spend to defend him, but _win._
**[So that's why we're reaching out to ask you — can you pitch in $5 or anything you're able to so we can ensure Ted Cruz's defeat next November?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-lc-20230929?refcode=em20230929&amount=5&refcode2=104_623276_MTtODq&akid=104%2E623276%2EMTtODq)**

body:
#
**_THE WASHINGTON POST:_** **“Biden to Create New Office of Gun Violence Prevention”**
Derek, this is a massive win for our youth-led movement to end gun violence across the country.
Alongside young activists, organizers, and leaders like John Fetterman, I'm proud to have fought for the creation of a federal office of gun violence prevention.
**Ending gun violence has been at the forefront of my campaign. It's what called me to action – both as the National Organizing Director for March for our Lives and as the first of my generation to be elected to Congress.**
My generation has been demanding action. And today, we have real, tangible progress in this fight. Not incremental progress, but a massive push forward.
**This is just the beginning. But I know the NRA and gun lobby are plotting revenge against our movement. John Fetterman and I need to be prepared, so we're setting out to raise $25,000 over the next 24 hours to keep me in the fight to end gun violence.[Can you split a $5 donation to my campaign and John Fetterman to power our movement for progress? »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20230929-1?refcode=em20230929-1-8596&refcode2=8596_434096_VvWNkS&akid=8596%2E434096%2EVvWNkS)**
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20230929-1?refcode=em20230929-8596&refcode2=8596_434096_VvWNkS&akid=8596%2E434096%2EVvWNkS)**
Derek, they said a young organizer wouldn't stand a chance against the gun lobby and the NRA-bought Republicans in Congress.
And when I introduced my first bill in Congress to establish a federal office of gun violence prevention, Republicans thought they succeeded in blocking it.
But I never gave up, and neither did John. Now, the Biden Administration is taking action. Our collective power made this happen. This is proof that our youth-powered movement is unstoppable. And we're just getting started.
**So today, we celebrate this win in the fight to end gun violence. Tomorrow, we _keep_ fighting. We _keep_ organizing. We _keep_ making noise.** But it's going to be an uphill battle against major forces that will stop at nothing to crush our progress. That's why John and I are counting on you to keep our movement strong – both on the ground and in Congress.
**[I'm asking every single person reading this to step up with a split donation today to help John Fetterman and me hit our $25,000 fundraising goal so we can keep up the fight to end gun violence. Can you rush a $5 split donation right now? >>](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20230929-1?refcode=em20230929-1-8596&refcode2=8596_434096_VvWNkS&akid=8596%2E434096%2EVvWNkS)**
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20230929-1?refcode=em20230929-8596&refcode2=8596_434096_VvWNkS&akid=8596%2E434096%2EVvWNkS)**

subject: Tomorrow is the last day
body:
Dear Peter

I am going to just come right out and ask you.

I need you to find it in your heart to make a donation to my campaign today. Tomorrow is the last day of the Q3 Fundraising report.

I'm Christian Castelli. 22 Year Combat Veteran. Decorated Green Beret. Successful Small Business Owner.

_You have a very important choice to make this election. Do you want congressman with conservative, proven, trusted, and tested experience?_

I am ready for the challenges we face as a country and families.

* We must eliminate record inflation.
* We must secure our border and stop the flood of illegal immigrants and illicit drugs like fentanyl.
* And we must restore parental rights across the board, but especially in our schools.

_Please a make a donation today._

**Let 's restore American values and American exceptionalism. **

**Your $25, $50, $100, or $250 donation before September 30 th will make a huge difference. **

We can defeat Joe Biden. We can defeat Democrats. And we can defeat their damaging policies! ** **

R. Christian Castelli
Lieutenant Colonel (Retired)
U.S. Army Special Forces
Republican Candidate for the U.S. House of Representatives
(336) 810-8100
[https://castellifornc.com](https://castellifornc.com/)

Earlier this week, Senator Bob Menendez held a press conference doubling down on his refusal to resign despite the serious and alarming corruption charges he's facing.
We deserve better. That's why I announced that I'm running to represent New Jersey in the United States Senate.
I want to be clear: this isn't about me. This is about New Jerseyans having a Senator who we can trust – beyond any doubt – to focus on the people's needs, not their own legal or political safety.
We can do better, friend. Can you make a split contribution to Serve America and my campaign to defeat Bob Menendez and restore integrity to the Senate? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-kim]
Public service is a privilege – an opportunity to serve our community. It should never be a license to line your pockets for political favors. I came to Congress to fight corruption and help clean up Washington, and I'm ready to continue that fight. Like so many, I've lost confidence in Senator Menendez. More soon,
Andy

Friend,

Not a lot of folks get to say this, but I will: Wes is the best boss.

First of all, he’s hard-working. Every day that we come into work, I’m inspired by Wes doing everything in his power to support and empower Marylanders.

As someone who spends so much with the Governor, I can also tell you that Wes Moore is the real deal. What you see online is what you get in person – a leader with endless energy and optimism for our state.
Wes means what he says — and when he said he was going to spend day in and day out to build a Maryland that works for everyone — he does. The Governor spends a lot of time working hard on behalf of all Marylanders that he doesn’t have time to fundraise — so this is where you come in. I’ll tell you that the best way to support our work at this moment is by making a contribution, even just a few bucks.

name: Mayor Sepi Shyne
subject: My statement on the passing of the trailblazing Senator Dianne Feinstein
body:
September 29, 2023

Dianne Feinstein [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/103922/images/IMG_5704-min.JPG]

Hello friend,

Today we learned of the passing of Senator Dianne Feinstein. When she was elected as part of “The Year of the Woman,” Senator Feinstein represented a world of possibility for women in leadership. She went on to leave a legacy of fighting for equity and justice for all, and historic victories for our LGBTQ+ community.

She was the longest-serving woman in the US Senate. I am saddened to hear of her passing this morning and so grateful for her years of service. She will be remembered as a mother, a trailblazer, and an inspiration for what is possible for so many. Please join me in honoring the life and legacy of Senator Feinstein today.

With gratitude,

Mayor Sepi Shyne
#WomanLifeFreedom

| | Friend,

Harvest season is right around the corner. That means pumpkins, Thanksgiving, farmers bringing in the harvest, and cooler temperatures.

Unfortunately, it is also the season when political campaigns often go cold.

I am writing to ask if you will help “**warm things up**.”

What do I mean?

It’s simple. At this time of year, people’s attention shifts to school, soccer, getting ready for the holidays, and more.

The last thing they are thinking about is political campaigns, and I can’t blame them.

I love this time of year and how the season shifts. Working through this summer, I wish I could have headed up to Hume Lake or Yosemite with my wife and boys for a few weeks.

But I can’t afford to take time off. I am committed to winning this race, not just compete.

_**There is too much at stake.**_ From the fentanyl crisis to foreign intrusions compromising our security to out-of-control crime and the “woke” agenda in our schools, our country is heading in the wrong direction. We must change course.

That is why I am determined to keep my eyes on the goal: winning our race for Congress.

So, as we approach the end of the month, I ask that you take a break from drinking your apple cider and watching football games to give to a vital cause: taking back our country.

[Please donate $100, $50, or $75](https://michaelmaher.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6239b7d9cb3ad9388556be8be&id=c4debe4b93&e=1722d05e10). Any donation will be most helpful. name: Jane Kwon
subject: Announcing OLCV’s 2023 Photo Contest Winners
body:
| | | Dear Peter, If you entered OLCV's 2023 Photo Contest, thank you! We received over 500 photos this year, and the OLCV staff was awed by so many of them. To help select runner-ups, we created the categories, “Landscapes”, “People & Pets”, and “Wildlife”. For “Landscapes”, the winner is Bob Davidson's photo of Succor Creek Canyon in Adrian, OR. Bob wrote along with his entry, “I love getting out to this area. It is still so wild and lonely.” Adah Crandall’s photo of a student hanging their screenprinting at the Portland Youth Climate Strike activism training last fall is the winner of the “People & Pets” category. Adah is a youth climate organizer and recent high school graduate, who wrote in her entry, “To me, this photo highlights the joy and community found in climate organizing and the power of art in building resilience.” The winner of the “Wildlife” category is Rena Olson’s photo of a Northern pygmy owl taken at Yakona Nature Preserve in South Beach. “I adore owls, and always feel blessed when I get to share space with them in nature. The importance of preserving and protecting our wild lands is truly felt when one is able to gaze into the eyes of one who calls those places home,” Rena wrote. And the grand-prize winner is... Teri Smith’s photo of trail work volunteers tending to fire-impacted trees and the green meadows of Jefferson Park! Teri wrote with her entry that it “represents our ongoing challenges to deal with climate change, fire and human impact.” Congratulations to all the winners! As the grand-prize winner, Teri's photo will be featured on the cover of OLCV’s 2023 Environmental Scorecard for the Oregon Legislature. It’s not published yet, but we’ll keep you posted so you can see how Oregon's lawmakers scored this year as soon as it's out. Thank you for participating, and congratulations again to all the winners! Photos from this year's photo contest will be up on our Facebook page early next week, so find and tag yours. Have a great weekend!
Jane Kwon
Communications Coordinator, OLCV |

subject: Re: A government shutdown

body:
This hostage-taking has got to stop.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=89%2E4032634%2EdEnk9i)
---
Let’s be clear about what’s going on in Washington right now: a handful of MAGA Republican extremists in the U.S. House are hellbent on imposing pain on the American people — even if it means shutting down the government or slashing vital programs — to improve Donald Trump’s chances of winning in 2024. They’re insisting upon drastic cuts to education, housing, nutrition assistance, heating assistance (just in time for winter), and more. And if they succeed in shutting down the government, babies would get kicked out of Head Start, moms and infants would have their nutrition assistance jeopardized, and service members would go without paychecks — all so a few Republican extremists can score political points. It’s outrageous. This hostage-taking has got to stop, and I’ll keep fighting by your side to make sure our government works for families. [**Add your name if you agree: House Republicans need to stop playing political games, do their jobs, and prevent a government shutdown. Let’s show the GOP that the American people are not on their side.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-shutdown/?source=EMZ16X_ENG_E_20230929_V1S1&t=8&akid=89%2E4032634%2EdEnk9i) ** | [**ADD YOUR NAME**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-shutdown/?source=EMZ16X_ENG_E_20230929_V1S1&t=13&akid=89%2E4032634%2EdEnk9i)

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70602526/429879834/62647395?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM1MzYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYzg5OWRkZDYtZWQ1ZS1lZTExLTk5MzctMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Y1vr8TTUoa93vTb7swbyrlW-DkgE_lU3XAltd5Wdepo=) Friend,

Earlier this month, our 2023 Assembly session officially came to a close. I'm excited to tell you about some of the important bills we passed to improve the quality of life for our community and all Californians.

[I want to share more about what we accomplished. But first, my FEC fundraising deadline hits tomorrow at midnight and we could use a final push to meet our quarterly goal. Please chip in $3 or more.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70602528/429879836/-1241314520?refcode=em-9.29.23-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM1MzYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYzg5OWRkZDYtZWQ1ZS1lZTExLTk5MzctMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Y1vr8TTUoa93vTb7swbyrlW-DkgE_lU3XAltd5Wdepo=)

---

I’ve had the honor of authoring and co-authoring a number of critical bills this year:

🚦 **Reducing traffic accidents and saving lives** through a program where drivers who are caught significantly speeding or street racing receive a nominal fee -- with no points on their license. Having heard so many stories about families ripped apart due to a loved one passing away or being seriously injured due to a speeding driver, I’ve worked on this bill for years. I will continue to prioritize the safety of my constituents.

✊ **Preventing striking workers from being driven to insolvency** through a multi-pronged effort, both by allowing striking California workers to receive unemployment benefits, and by creating a loan program to keep striking workers from risking homelessness. Losing everything should not be the price workers pay for standing up for their rights, and these measure provide a safety net to protect workers and our economy.

💧 **Protecting our natural resources** by partnering with our water agencies to ensure drinking water isn’t wasted by cities and commercial users on ornamental, non-functional turf.

🚈 **Delivering on improved infrastructure** by authoring key legislation and participating in the working group which negotiated the package which will accelerate construction timelines on projects to help meet our climate and clean energy goals. Infrastructure investment is how we address some of our most pressing environmental and social issues. By fast-tracking projects that reduce our carbon footprint, we’ll get there.

These are just a few of the major things we accomplished this year, and I want to deliver more for California in Congress:

[Please help me get there with your support. In this competitive race, every dollar ahead of our end-of-quarter filing deadline matters. Chip in $3 if you can.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70602533/429879841/-1241314520?refcode=em-9.29.23-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM1MzYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYzg5OWRkZDYtZWQ1ZS1lZTExLTk5MzctMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Y1vr8TTUoa93vTb7swbyrlW-DkgE_lU3XAltd5Wdepo=)
****[Donate](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70602536/429879844/-1241314520?refcode=em-9.29.23-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM1MzYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYzg5OWRkZDYtZWQ1ZS1lZTExLTk5MzctMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Y1vr8TTUoa93vTb7swbyrlW-DkgE_lU3XAltd5Wdepo=)****

I’m not running for Congress for name recognition or the thrill of hearing my own voice. I’m running because I’m committed to creating a California that is equipped to thrive and be enjoyed by my daughter and the generations that follow her.

I’m glad to have your support as we work to make that happen.

Laura

clean_body: | = Friend, Earlier this month, our 2023 Assembly session officially came to a close. I'm excited to tell you about some of the important bills we passed to improve the quality of life for our community and all Californians. = | **= I’ve had the honor of authoring and co-authoring a number of critical bills this year: 🚦 Reducing traffic accidents and saving lives through a program where drivers who are caught significantly speeding or street racing receive a nominal fee -- with no points on their license. Having heard so many stories about families ripped apart due to a loved one passing away or being seriously injured due to a speeding driver, I’ve worked on this bill for years. I will continue to prioritize the safety of my constituents. ✊ Preventing striking workers from being driven to insolvency through a multi-pronged effort, both by allowing striking California workers to receive unemployment benefits, and by creating a loan program to keep striking workers from risking homelessness. Losing everything should not be the price workers pay for standing up for their rights, and these measure provide a safety net to protect workers and our economy. 💧 Protecting our natural resources by partnering with our water agencies to ensure drinking water isn’t wasted by cities and commercial users on ornamental, non-functional turf. 🚈 Delivering on improved infrastructure by authoring key legislation and participating in the working group which negotiated the package which will accelerate construction timelines on projects to help meet our climate and clean energy goals. Infrastructure investment is how we address some of our most pressing environmental and social issues. By fast-tracking projects that reduce our carbon footprint, we’ll get there. These are just a few of the major things we accomplished this year, and I want to deliver more for California in Congress: = = I’m not running for Congress for name recognition or the thrill of hearing my own voice. I’m running because I’m committed to creating a California that is equipped to thrive and be enjoyed by my daughter and the generations that follow her. I’m glad to have your support as we work to make that happen. body:
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=30625%2E3422442%2E51CuPo)
Today we woke up to the sad news that California Senator Feinstein passed away.
As the first woman to represent California in the Senate, Dianne Feinstein paved the way for generations of women to serve—including me. She was elected in 1992, which was dubbed the ‘year of the woman.’ The year prior, there were just two women serving in the United States Senate. She was a true trailblazer.
She left her mark in tough fights against gun violence, torture, and homophobia. From writing and championing the 1994 nationwide assault weapons ban to helping reauthorize the Violence Against Women Act, her legacy will live on.
I’m thinking of her loved ones during this difficult time.
Katie Porter

Friend, Activists in Georgia have been protesting “Cop City,” a massive training center for militarizing police. For exercising their constitutional rights, protesters have been charged with domestic terrorism—and one nonviolent activist known as Tortuguita was murdered by police. **Rep. Cori Bush and I are some of the few national political leaders calling for justice for Tortuguita and condemning this extreme police overreach, which is an unconstitutional attempt to silence dissent that violates our First Amendment rights.** Cori and I have experienced police violence against protesters marching in defense of Black lives in Ferguson and Detroit. We understand that spending more on police budgets doesn’t keep our communities safe. In fact, it keeps Black and brown communities in fear of regular harassment and violence. So Cori and I are carrying forward the grassroots call to overhaul our criminal legal system.**In Congress, we’re championing legislation to build true public safety by investing in the basic needs of our communities, funding public health alternatives to policing, expanding our civil rights laws, and more.** [**Please chip in $5 or more today so Cori Bush and I can keep pushing for bold policy solutions to police violence and keep fighting back against dangerous attacks on our right to protest.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953w1cdrvm2TShU3fAiYbO3lKcT6GzsVXTkTNNEfjTunO75WWjDtKce262MkTqA2k062nLUaPuK1aDBV9nG7nUxIcUKPPMdnO2blgeHE56UTwJMQjUnWE5u7rL2UfK2c2KiT3BIChPfzEEBPs50FYWDo8UtRiYryJcx1OQXVxum7oRyJ2n-cg_kx_6iUI0jy06Ir5Vme04NnnsI121sT0sCn_K2aWZV6JsXA1FIqWRBppphsOCSXytgZ-ZQPm-fZ-pJvmGK6AaG7J1dX95XZxd49T3ISwPhS2gw22BA2zdeMaZyBq4-Fan1otkBaD3pL3jo7AJ2nrww4l5jO7bFr78cUf/400/lPsXzp70QSiWZioI4A0UuA/h1/W6js-sPaMTimkcmfK2ONy9-6Wa2Em30XYbvFW1hZ7mQ) _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your secure donation will go through immediately, split evenly between Cori Bush and Rashida Tlaib_ | | | [Chip in $15 now](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953w1cdrvm2TShU3fAiYbO3lKcT6GzsVXTkTNNEfjTunO72fVIK064SwOo8IiOaeu4Ivk9vZOOmdgV88AVRDkFHx5RhuhE9u4KDOeijQ5hxcGXd2JKSe0HEXtscMXKiUPGxrhAIA1m_HKohea0lbkF1-_g7U5xnCEHJkCiYcschU5Yt5ibpvWX4zpjkBAdGXt0R5JEFlXF-GM7TpCKJ1VUSHohRzliTuJj3hMfr-3aBDS1Idb975PqD2Z-7VD1ehJsoYVcPKzxdRVhZJLm6UiIvq2rCQj7Ik49dqvDbBORXbILEPuUArdD_0U_m42Mg5Yv67zHrd1blm4mSLR1fA-zgeZBF4v4qYHPPVKDlUCKjFkNZ6XtTYUDF_T--qd1U281xk/400/lPsXzp70QSiWZioI4A0UuA/h2/66bXYuxFhKMOtJux3Ix8PjMlobz7Ey7pBUSdmwEQ9xo)

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. | | Hello friends,

**So Who Are the Candidates in Contested Races?**

One of the biggest barriers in getting folks to vote in school board elections is a lack of information about the people running.

First-year RVCC student / Hunterdon County Clerk intern Vic Komosinski knows this, and for the second year running has worked to gather and provide information on contested BOE races in Hunterdon County. She writes, “My name is Vic Komosinski and I’m a first year student at RVCC. This is my second year doing this project. I came up with the idea for this project after the County Clerk, Mary Melfi, came to speak to my AP Government and Politics class 2 years ago. I realized just how little information is available to people who wish to learn about candidates before voting, especially in small town elections. With the help of Mary Melfi, I was able to reach out to the school board candidates of contested elections, asking them to fill out a brief questionnaire to help educate the public. I’m incredibly proud of this project, and I hope that people use it to cast educated and thoughtful ballots.” You can find this [information about contested Hunterdon BOE races here.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70605972/429889816/-1298302664?fbclid=IwAR1aSB37aC4pGwqjex84Bl0Qp2SM09ThdbOPdJEaxbBpiJFzG7to3xCy_2w/&refcode=EM_NBI_DFD_20230929_OT_news_0_3MO_DG_na_na_newsletter&refcode2=f19779eb-f25e-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82MzYzOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMTk3NzllYi1mMjVlLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=P9GvfQJp__w3bA7ES2fMuCjuU9UBDa1_hhkdDPIBvn4=&emci=44cf7b1c-e15e-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&emdi=f19779eb-f25e-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&ceid=19214294)

**Districts for Democracy**

[Click here for the list of candidates in contested races who we believe are aligned with the values we discuss below.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70605973/429889817/157604416?refcode=EM_NBI_DFD_20230929_OT_news_0_3MO_DG_na_na_newsletter&refcode2=f19779eb-f25e-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82MzYzOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMTk3NzllYi1mMjVlLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=P9GvfQJp__w3bA7ES2fMuCjuU9UBDa1_hhkdDPIBvn4=&emci=44cf7b1c-e15e-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&emdi=f19779eb-f25e-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&ceid=19214294)

We believe public schools need to work for every student and every parent. That simple idea goes to the very heart of what makes public education so important, what makes communities strong, what brings value to taxpayers, and what builds a brighter future.

Our public schools serve us best when they do what they do best: teaching students _how_ to think–not _what_ to think. Banning books and targeting vulnerable young people have no place in any public school. And frankly, none of this should be controversial.

While Districts for Democracy does not endorse candidates, we do value individuals who share these fundamental ideals. Candidates must:
* Be committed to fostering a supportive environment for teachers and recognize their vital role in our education system.

* Demonstrate a commitment to ensuring that every student, regardless of their background or beliefs, has access to a supportive school environment.

Finally, we think our classrooms should remain focused on education, and candidates who prioritize this over fanning the flames of partisan culture wars (and spending local tax dollars on lawsuits instead of students), align with our mission to support quality education for all.

The 2023 candidate data provided on our website will be updated regularly from now until November as we continue to research candidates. If you think there is a race or a great candidate we’ve missed, please email team@districtsfordemocracy.com with your feedback.

**BoardofEducation.Vote**

[Boardofeducation.vote](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70605974/429889818/-108102805?refcode=EM_NBI_DFD_20230929_OT_news_0_3MO_DG_na_na_newsletter&refcode2=f19779eb-f25e-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82MzYzOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMTk3NzllYi1mMjVlLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=P9GvfQJp__w3bA7ES2fMuCjuU9UBDa1_hhkdDPIBvn4=&emci=44cf7b1c-e15e-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&emdi=f19779eb-f25e-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&ceid=19214294) is an initiative of Action Together New Jersey, a 501(c)4 nonprofit social and civic organization. The mission of ATNJ is to build community advocacy efforts through civic education and grassroots action. **Its work in educating the public about Board of Education candidates is strictly nonpartisan.**

Starting October 1, 2023, the [BoardofEducation.vote](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70605975/429889819/-108102805?refcode=EM_NBI_DFD_20230929_OT_news_0_3MO_DG_na_na_newsletter&refcode2=f19779eb-f25e-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82MzYzOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMTk3NzllYi1mMjVlLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=P9GvfQJp__w3bA7ES2fMuCjuU9UBDa1_hhkdDPIBvn4=&emci=44cf7b1c-e15e-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&emdi=f19779eb-f25e-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&ceid=19214294) website will provide candidate information for school board races in New Jersey. [Click here to see who is listed.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70605976/429889820/126333688?refcode=EM_NBI_DFD_20230929_OT_news_0_3MO_DG_na_na_newsletter&refcode2=f19779eb-f25e-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82MzYzOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMTk3NzllYi1mMjVlLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=P9GvfQJp__w3bA7ES2fMuCjuU9UBDa1_hhkdDPIBvn4=&emci=44cf7b1c-e15e-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&emdi=f19779eb-f25e-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&ceid=19214294) Data will be updated through October 9, 2023.

[Information about how the group reached out to candidates, and who may or may not be listed, can be found here.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70605977/429889821/-389985060?refcode=EM_NBI_DFD_20230929_OT_news_0_3MO_DG_na_na_newsletter&refcode2=f19779eb-f25e-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82MzYzOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMTk3NzllYi1mMjVlLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=P9GvfQJp__w3bA7ES2fMuCjuU9UBDa1_hhkdDPIBvn4=&emci=44cf7b1c-e15e-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&emdi=f19779eb-f25e-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&ceid=19214294)

**NJ BOE Candidates Endorsed by Moms For Liberty and New Jersey Project**

Currently, these are the candidates publicly supported by the hard-right, extremist organizations Moms for Liberty and New Jersey Project.

We do not believe these candidates align with our mission to keep public schools a public good. If someone endorsed by these organizations is running for a seat on your local BOE, please look more closely at their candidacy and consider whether their values align with your own when it comes to schools, students, and public education:

[2023 Morris County Moms for Liberty Endorsements](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70605978/429889822/1313753472?refcode=EM_NBI_DFD_20230929_OT_news_0_3MO_DG_na_na_newsletter&refcode2=f19779eb-f25e-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82MzYzOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMTk3NzllYi1mMjVlLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=P9GvfQJp__w3bA7ES2fMuCjuU9UBDa1_hhkdDPIBvn4=&emci=44cf7b1c-e15e-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&emdi=f19779eb-f25e-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&ceid=19214294) (more M4L New Jersey endorsements expected soon)

[2023 New Jersey Project Candidate Endorsements](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70605979/429889827/-1180763348?refcode=EM_NBI_DFD_20230929_OT_news_0_3MO_DG_na_na_newsletter&refcode2=f19779eb-f25e-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82MzYzOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMTk3NzllYi1mMjVlLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=P9GvfQJp__w3bA7ES2fMuCjuU9UBDa1_hhkdDPIBvn4=&emci=44cf7b1c-e15e-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&emdi=f19779eb-f25e-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&ceid=19214294)

**More to Come**

We will continue to talk with candidates so we can provide current information on BOE races across the state. Check the sites above often to watch for updates.

And as we’ve highlighted before, there are simple ways you can help: Write a letter to the editor about who you’re supporting in your local election and why. Talk to your neighbors. Email your friends. Send postcards to people in town. Like and share candidate Facebook pages and other social media posts. Offer to canvass for or with candidates. Every door knocked can mean a vote won.

No one can succeed alone, but together we can win.

The next few weeks will be some of the most important in 2023. I’m glad we’re committed to helping our teachers, kids, and classrooms. Thank you again for your attention, and your time. Let’s keep New Jersey public schools number one in the nation.

Sincerely,

Darcy
Executive Director
Districts for Democracy

clean_body: | | Hello friends, So Who Are the Candidates in Contested Races? One of the biggest barriers in getting folks to vote in school board elections is a lack of information about the people running. First-year RVCC student / Hunterdon County Clerk intern Vic Komosinski knows this, and for the second year running has worked to gather and provide information on contested BOE races in Hunterdon County. She writes, “My name is Vic Komosinski and I’m a first year student at RVCC. This is my second year doing this project. I came up with the idea for this project after the County Clerk, Mary Melfi, came to speak to my AP Government and Politics class 2 years ago. I realized just how little information is available to people who wish to learn about candidates before voting, especially in small town elections. With the help of Mary Melfi, I was able to reach out to the school board candidates of contested elections, asking them to fill out a brief questionnaire to help educate the public. I’m incredibly proud of this project, and I hope that people use it to cast educated and thoughtful ballots.” You can find this Districts for Democracy We believe public schools need to work for every student and every parent. That simple idea goes to the very heart of what makes public education so important, what makes communities strong, what brings value to taxpayers, and what builds a brighter future. Our public schools serve us best when they do what they do best: teaching students how to think–not what to think. Banning books and targeting vulnerable young people have no place in any public school. And frankly, none of this should be controversial. While Districts for Democracy does not endorse candidates, we do value individuals who share these fundamental ideals. Candidates must: Be committed to fostering a supportive environment for teachers and recognize their vital role in our education system. Demonstrate a commitment to ensuring that every student, regardless of their background or beliefs, has access to a supportive school environment. Finally, we think our classrooms should remain focused on education, and candidates who prioritize this over fanning the flames of partisan culture wars (and spending local tax dollars on lawsuits instead of students), align with our mission to support quality education for all. The 2023 candidate data provided on our website will be updated regularly from now until November as we continue to research candidates. If you think there is a race or a great candidate we’ve missed, please email team@districtsfordemocracy.com with your feedback. BoardofEducation.Vote is an initiative of Action Together New Jersey, a 501(c)4 nonprofit social and civic organization. The mission of ATNJ is to build community advocacy efforts through civic education and grassroots action. Its work in educating the public about Board of Education candidates is strictly nonpartisan. Starting October 1, 2023, the website will provide candidate information for school board races in New Jersey. Data will be updated through October 9, 2023. NJ BOE Candidates Endorsed by Moms For Liberty and New Jersey Project Currently, these are the candidates publicly supported by the hard-right, extremist organizations Moms for Liberty and New Jersey Project. We do not believe these candidates align with our mission to keep public schools a public good. If someone endorsed by these organizations is running for a seat on your local BOE, please look more closely at their candidacy and consider whether their values align with your own when it comes to schools, students, and public education: (more M4L New Jersey endorsements expected soon) More to Come We will continue to talk with candidates so we can provide current information on BOE races across the state. Check the sites above often to watch for updates. And as we’ve highlighted before, there are simple ways you can help: Write a letter to the editor about who you’re supporting in your local election and why. Talk to your neighbors. Email your friends. Send postcards to people in town. Like and share candidate Facebook pages and other social media posts. Offer to canvass for or with candidates. Every door knocked can mean a vote won. No one can succeed alone, but together we can win. The next few weeks will be some of the most important in 2023. I’m glad we’re committed to helping our teachers, kids, and classrooms. Thank you again for your attention, and your time. Let’s keep New Jersey public schools number one in the nation. Sincerely, Darcy Executive Director Districts for Democracy * | Districts for Democracy will work one school board, legislative, and congressional district at a time to recruit and support candidates committed to freedom of inquiry, thought, and speech for everyone. Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. # **A Message from the Chairwoman**
---
| |
# _Save the Date_
---
Team, I know we are all rightfully focused on the extremely important upcoming 2023 municipal elections. That being said, 2024 is right around the corner, and we want all of our grassroots leaders across the state to be prepared. As such, please save the date for our 2024 Congress of Counties gathering which will be held on Friday, February 23 - Saturday, February 24, 2024, at the Crowne Plaza/Union Station in downtown Indianapolis. The weekend will include a number of informative training sessions with some of the topics including communications, social media best practices, grassroots tools, data updates, coalition building and more. While this weekend is about equipping our grassroots activists with the best tools to run campaigns, it is also about having fun! Please save the date and keep an eye out for more details to come. We are looking forward to seeing many of you in February!
---
---
Chairwoman Anne F. Hathaway

# ⚕️ _Helping Hoosiers_
---
---
| | _**Governor Eric Holcomb** provides remarks during the unveiling of a new tool to fight addiction._**
---
This week,**Governor Eric Holcomb** announced the launch of Shatterproof Treatment Atlas, a free, confidential, first-of-its-kind tool to connect Hoosiers in need with appropriate addiction treatment and deliver user-friendly information about the quality of available programs.
* Indiana is one of 13 states to partner with Shatterproof, a national nonprofit organization dedicated to ending addiction, to launch Treatment Atlas.

**What he's saying:** “Hoosiers with substance use disorder deserve timely access to quality care as soon as they’re ready to accept help,” **Gov. Holcomb** said. **
* “Treatment Atlas puts recovery within immediate reach, giving Hoosiers and their loved ones a trusted resource to find evidence-based, high-quality treatment that meets their unique needs, anywhere in the state.”

**The details:** The dashboard lists all 605 addiction treatment facilities certified by DMHA and measures addiction treatment facilities’ use of evidence-based practices through a combination of validated data sources and reports them publicly.
* Along with the option to filter and search in-state providers through the platform using these criteria, Hoosiers have the option to take an anonymous 10-question Addiction Treatment Needs Assessment to help identify and understand the appropriate level of care they need.

**What else happened this week?****Gov. Holcomb**[broke ground](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/714339781d6bb6083947229f28c3afba/fc2b21bb47710d19c3d6b838967d376c/40313) on a new state prison.****

Holcomb** on [Facebook](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/714339781d6bb6083947229f28c3afba/4eec577986da0cb4c3d6b838967d376c/40313) or [Twitter](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/714339781d6bb6083947229f28c3afba/0b924ce89e37d683c3d6b838967d376c/40313).

# 📰 _IBJ & Indiana Capital Chronicle: State Comptroller Tera Klutz to Step Down_
---
From _[The IBJ and Indiana Capital Chronicle:](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/714339781d6bb6083947229f28c3afba/de3dbed1d51f63f9c3d6b838967d376c/40313)_ "**State Comptroller Tera Klutz** announced Thursday that she would be retiring from her position on Dec. 1 after 20 years in public service. She has more than three years left in her term.

"Klutz was appointed as the 57th auditor of the state by Indiana **Gov. Eric Holcomb** in 2017, becoming the first certified public accountant to serve as the state’s chief financial officer.

"She was elected to the position in 2018 and reelected in 2022. Her title was changed to state comptroller on July 1 by state statute." _[Story continues.](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/714339781d6bb6083947229f28c3afba/f8ce99d29589cd21c3d6b838967d376c/40313)_ Statement from **Chairwoman Hathaway** : _"Since her very first day in office,**Tera Klutz** has been an exemplary public servant. As the first ever CPA to hold the office, Tera worked tirelessly to increase transparency to the office of Indiana State Auditor, now State Comptroller. Tera built and led a team who was always focused on delivering great government service at a great value to taxpayers. Please join us in thanking Tera for her many years of local and state public service." _

From _[The Bedford Gazette:](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/714339781d6bb6083947229f28c3afba/1d4da41a4d495189c3d6b838967d376c/40313)_ "Successful recovery from drug addiction goes beyond overdose reversal drugs and rehab, advocates say, amid a statewide push to prioritize social and community support for former users. “'People that use substances aren’t bad people and I think the realization is setting in that (addiction) can happen to anybody,' Breanne Pugh, a project coordinator with the Washington County Drug and Alcohol Commission, said. "In Washington County alone, the commission gave out more than 2,000 Narcan kits in the last year to better prepare the public if they encounter anyone who’s overdosed. Let's back up for a second. Before I was ever an EMILYs List-endorsed candidate, I was a member of this millions-strong pro-choice community, just like you.

Back in the 1980s, when I was teaching law, I got a piece of mail from EMILYs List. As I read all about this brand-new organization aiming to help elect Democratic pro-choice women, I thought, _"Hey, that's a good idea!" _So I mailed back a small check and became a _proud_ EMILYs List member.

Decades later, in 2011, I was contemplating a run for U.S. Senate in Massachusetts. Stephanie Schriock, then-president of EMILYs List, flew to Boston, sat across a table from me, and helped me decide to throw my hat in the ring. So I ran — and, with the support of EMILYs List, I _won_.

I know firsthand how powerful support from EMILYs List can be. And this cycle, the EMILYs List team has already endorsed dozens of women – myself included – who will dream big and fight hard to protect the rights and opportunities of _all_ Americans. But they can't support any of these rockstar candidates without this team, Peter. **That's why I'm reaching out today, ahead of the biggest fundraising deadline so far this year, to ask for your support.**

Hi Peter,
I’ll try to make this as quick as possible.
Tomorrow is the last day of the quarter. Afterward, all our numbers will become public — and my Republican opponent will know exactly how strong our campaign is.
There’s no sugarcoating it: last quarter, my opponent outraised us. Even though we brought in hundreds of more individual donations, he got big checks from fossil fuel giants, Big Pharma, the gun lobby, and Kevin McCarthy.
This quarter, we must show we have the grassroots support to take on my opponent and his wealthy donors.
Our campaign already has incredible momentum. We’ve been endorsed by the League of Conservation Voters, Emily’s List, End Citizens United, labor unions, and public servants like Mark Kelly and Kris Mayes. With over a year to go, we’ve already received more national support than we did at any point last year.
I know we can flip this seat — but first, we need to hit our fundraising goal.
Last year, we came so close to winning. Even though we were outspent 6:1, we only lost by one percentage point. Next year will be different.
Arizona’s Sixth Congressional District deserves a leader who will fight for our working families, reproductive rights, schools, water security, and local economy. That’s exactly what I’ll do.

body:
[ stdin# ][IMG]

Peter Willis,

This morning, California Senator and trailblazing political figure Diane Feinstein passed away at the age of 90.

On behalf of the entire team at Our Revolution, we offer our deepest condolences to Senator Feinstein’s family, friends, and loved ones.

After becoming the first female mayor of San Francisco in 1978, Feinstein would become California’s first female Senator in 1992. Her career in the Senate was defined by action on key issues, including gun violence prevention, a re-authorization of the Violence Against Women Act, environmental protection, and championing LGBTQ+ equality.

California has lost a political giant — but the work of legislating on behalf of the people does not stop.

In 2021, when asked if he would nominate a Black woman to fill Diane Feinstein’s seat, Governor Gavin Newsom said, “The answer is yes.”

We’re calling on Governor Newsom to fulfill his promise and appoint Barbara Lee to the US Senate in California. Barbara Lee is the most experienced and effective legislator. She has the support of the Congressional Black Caucus and the leadership of the Congressional Progressive Caucus. The progressive movement is also behind Barbara Lee. The choice is clear.

Honoring the legacy of a trailblazing political giant like Diane Feinstein means appointing an effective legislator to keep up the fight — NOT a caretaker.

That’s why we’re asking you to sign on today and join us in calling for Governor Newsom to appoint Barbara Lee to the US Senate in California. Thank you,

Our Revolution

| | Fellow Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don't say this to shock or scare you - I say it because it's true. _What we see today didn 't happen overnight. It's the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making..._ **... and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast tracking their agenda.** I'd know better than most. When I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. 50 years ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited _Ramparts_ - radical Left's largest magazine. I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. My eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my "comrades" made possible. So I left and never looked back. I cast my 1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan - then I started the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left and I've dedicated the last 40 years to exposing them. Why? Because I knew first-hand the threat our country was facing. I knew what was at stake and I knew if I didn't tell the American people what I knew, we would lose our country forever. That's why I spent 6 months writing** _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_** - and I want you to have your very own copy of it. **[So I'm asking you to stand with me and make a generous, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to my Freedom Center. As a thank you, I'll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within.](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=999b0c42e75549ca93cdb346ecbe4c1c&_e=3juNdO9dnV8xrTKz5cg7RRzJcnIsvt2Hg0G9UiXycsVaaYZDHRgeHKPHy34HePESYyfNcXQEOZ5YCG1cyJ20jPcYCJNV4E_cWSsaykGl6onOcj3A1vecGmYmwTede0mspLOJfUxJv1FbnztGYNKRyvhSb2f9CpOFQRJR0lOAtiKWeoLCetTLm8R11e8Pbll0gOM8NMoCF9_bKuqXf6-4ejqYzDiVTOEITKQvk0eARdIqJvuwr7Z5k1JmM9UF2YAH7BMdu_ABpoSuXTdXpF70W2YsbVaQOEKMpkYxXscxnMIj3bZXTuG67TgNZm6ZXqOb1wsfDRMO6G2C-3_p0OChHL4-VgRYv9hmykoaLgHk6XK3IcIgBP7dHZ02TFIU0Ib_5vHbpXwQNuHOTgJk31sr6Q%3D%3D)** When you think of "the enemy within" you may think of Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi or even Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez...and you wouldn't be wrong. But make no mistake: **The real mastermind is Barack Obama.** Barack Obama laid the groundwork for everything we've seen since 2020 back in 2008. Barack Obama led the destruction of our cities, cozying up to Black Lives Matter radicals and siding with criminals over police upholding the rule of law. Barack Obama championed the castration of our military, making us a laughingstock on the world stage. And Barack Obama was the true architect behind the bogus Russian collusion witch hunt. The devastation and destruction we see today has been over a decade in the making - but most of the American people have no clue what we're up against. **That 's why I wrote _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_ to explain how communist and fascist Leftists infiltrated and overtook the Democrat Party...** ...how it has become a party of racism and hatred attacking the very foundations of our country... ... and how their ultimate goal is to create a one-party state - and cancel, deplatform and silence every last one of their political opponents by slandering them as "white supremacists" and worse. The reviews speak for themselves... "A Great Book" - Dinesh D'Souza "_The Enemy Within_ is a book for all patriots who understand that our country is in a fight for its life." - Mark Levin "David Horowitz does it again in a must-read for any American concerned about where we are headed as a nation." Laura Ingraham I wrote _The Enemy Within_ because... I know if our country stands a chance, Americans must understand exactly how sinister and dangerous the new Democrat Party actually is. I was the enemy within -- and I know in my bones what it will take to defeat them. We've reached the point in our history that will decide our future - and we either win these political battles or lose everything that makes us prosperous and free. **[That's why I'll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within when you donate $35 or more to the Freedom Center today and give us the ammunition we need to expose the Left's evil agenda to every American patriot.](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=999b0c42e75549ca93cdb346ecbe4c1c&_e=3juNdO9dnV8xrTKz5cg7RRzJcnIsvt2Hg0G9UiXycsVaaYZDHRgeHKPHy34HePESYyfNcXQEOZ5YCG1cyJ20jPcYCJNV4E_cWSsaykGl6onOcj3A1vecGmYmwTede0mspLOJfUxJv1FbnztGYNKRyvhSb2f9CpOFQRJR0lOAtiKWeoLCetTLm8R11e8Pbll0gOM8NMoCF9_bKuqXf6-4ejqYzDiVTOEITKQvk0eARdIqJvuwr7Z5k1JmM9UF2YAHLhp_R3e_XgjUb-FmEAmXCino73mn-jpKBUltozD0et2juholifZif7Y8vceeO_AJKH4ulCn7_Oo4kDrhJ_fV8iHq0hQ4W4nAoJZX5-CGDts7wCOWqcdqMn-0z6S1ofgzAxvnK2Ro8QRYBd_j2zoJQQ%3D%3D)** The Left is at war with America. They don't simply disagree with us about how to make our country better - they want to destroy it to make way for their Marxist dystopia. Or in Obama's own words "radically transform" America. **And they don 't care how much they have to lie, cheat or steal to achieve it.** So it's up to patriots like you and me to expose the truth about the Left to our fellow Americans while we still can.

name: Adam Schiff
subject: Senator Dianne Feinstein (1933-2023)
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR SENATE
body:
| Senator Dianne Feinstein was a trail-blazer, a woman of enormous strength and determination, a courageous public servant who set the example of what a public servant could accomplish.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=4165%2E5257348%2E3uZ_Vy)
Dear Derek,
The state of California, and our entire nation, have lost a giant of the United States Senate.
**Senator Dianne Feinstein was a trailblazer, a woman of enormous strength and determination, a courageous public servant who set the example of what a public servant could accomplish.**
But Senator Dianne Feinstein was not only a trail-blazing leader, she was also my friend. And I will deeply miss her.
The Senator’s legacy is unmatched. She was one of the finest legislators we have ever seen, and her accomplishments made our country and world a better place.
Thrust into the national spotlight by an act of gun violence perpetrated against San Francisco Mayor George Moscone and Supervisor Harvey Milk, Senator Feinstein single-handedly pushed an assault weapons ban over the finish line in the Senate, and she never gave up her fight to end gun violence. Three decades after that ban, she cast one of the deciding votes on another bipartisan gun safety bill signed into law last year.
As the longtime chair of the Senate Intelligence Committee, she took on powerful federal agencies to investigate and uncover torture, to ensure it never happened again. She studied the issues carefully, and diligently, and set a standard for professionalism that I tried to emulate as chair of the House Intelligence Committee.
She was a steward of California’s natural beauty and preserving its lands for future generations.
She fought tirelessly for LGBTQ rights and women’s equality. And never stopped.
My heart is with Senator Feinstein’s family, friends and staff at this difficult time.
**California is with them. And so is the nation.**
We are all indebted to the Senator and her family for her decades of service, and we are all better off for her dogged efforts to build a more perfect union.
With gratitude,
Adam Schiff

body:
[1]Lucas Kunce for U.S. Senate

Hey Peter, I’m
Lucas’ campaign manager. It’s been a few months since you’ve heard from
me, and the frank reason is this: The last few months have been crazy.

First, National Republicans launched a bizarre campaign against Lucas
attacking him for... playing a card game and having been a cheerleader in
college. No, really.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/37555?refcode=em20230929-3875&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=3875%2E614464%2EIWXB2c ]Tweet from Lucas that reads 'Guilty!' in response to a tweet from the
NRSC that reads: :crying laughing emoji: NERD ALERT: Democrat Senate
Candidate Lucas Kunce Likes Magic The Gather, Was First Male Cheerleader
at Yale

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/37555?refcode=em20230929-3875&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=3875%2E614464%2EIWXB2c ]HELP LUCAS FIGHT BACK »

Just 12 days later, we learned we had outraised Josh Hawley for Q1. Not
long after, the Missouri Fire Fighters endorsed Lucas against Hawley —
despite having endorsed Republican Senators in the past. Both were huge
early signs for Lucas’ ability to win.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/37555?refcode=em20230929-3875&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=3875%2E614464%2EIWXB2c ]On the left, a chart showing Lucas Kunce outraised Josh Hawley in the
first fundraising quarter of 2023. Lucas raised $1.1M, Hawley raised
$600k. On the right, an excerpt of the Missouri Fire Fighters' endorsement
of Lucas Kunce as reported in the St. Louis Labor Tribune.

Then, Lucas and Marilyn welcomed Harvey to the world — but Harvey came 7
weeks early, which meant Lucas had to spend time off the campaign trail as
he traveled between home and the NICU. He’s out and doing great now too!

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/37555?refcode=em20230929-3875&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1004&akid=3875%2E614464%2EIWXB2c ]Photos of Lucas and Marilyn with Harvey in the NICU and heading home.

The Missouri AFL-CIO endorsed Lucas, along with many more statewide and
local labor unions. Since Lucas got back on the trail, we had a big
pro-worker rally in St. Louis with hundreds of everyday Missourians fired
up to elect Lucas and defeat Hawley — along with packed crowds at events
covering every corner of the state!

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/37555?refcode=em20230929-3875&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1005&akid=3875%2E614464%2EIWXB2c ]On the left, a photo of Lucas addressing a room full of people in
Moniteau County. On the right, a photo of Lucas waving to supporters at a
big rally with workers in St. Louis County.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/37555?refcode=em20230929-3875&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1006&akid=3875%2E614464%2EIWXB2c ]HELP LUCAS FIGHT BACK »

With the support of Missouri’s election-winning labor coalition, along
with a record-breaking movement of grassroots donors, Lucas’ campaign has
simply been on fire the last few months. And it’s making a difference. New
polling shows Josh Hawley is the least popular incumbent of any GOP
Senator up in 2024 — even more unpopular than Ted Cruz and Rick Scott!
This race is turning into a dead heat:

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/37555?refcode=em20230929-3875&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1007&akid=3875%2E614464%2EIWXB2c ]On the left, a graph that shows Josh Hawley has the worst approval
rating of any GOP Senate candidate running in 2024, even worse than Ted
Cruz and Rick Scott. On the right, a graph of a new poll that shows Lucas
in a statistical tie with Josh Hawley.

But with all this success, it’s gotten Hawley worried. Don’t just take my
word for it — here’s a message he sent his donors just a few days ago:
“Missouri could be one of the closest Senate races in America. In fact,
control of the Senate could come down to us.”

And now, corporate elites and GOP mega-donors have launched a new Super
PAC to prop up Hawley and attack Lucas, already seeding it with $1
MILLION. If you think that makes me nervous, you’d be right — but it’s
also the surest sign yet that Lucas Kunce can win this race.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/37555?refcode=em20230929-3875&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1008&akid=3875%2E614464%2EIWXB2c ]So today, just a little under 12 hours before our final day of
fundraising for the quarter, I’m asking you to chip in a donation of any
amount to help us fight back and win this race. This is our chance to hold
Hawley accountable and to take this U.S. Senate back for working families
in Missouri — and we can’t waste it:

If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your
contribution instantly:

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/37556?refcode=em20230929-3875&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=1009&akid=3875%2E614464%2EIWXB2c ]Contribute $10
[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/37556?refcode=em20230929-3875&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=1010&akid=3875%2E614464%2EIWXB2c ]Contribute $25
[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/37556?refcode=em20230929-3875&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=30&t=1011&akid=3875%2E614464%2EIWXB2c ]Contribute $30
[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/37556?refcode=em20230929-3875&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=50&t=1012&akid=3875%2E614464%2EIWXB2c ]Contribute $50
[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/37556?refcode=em20230929-3875&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=100&t=1013&akid=3875%2E614464%2EIWXB2c ]Contribute $100
[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/37556?refcode=em20230929-3875&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=250&t=1014&akid=3875%2E614464%2EIWXB2c ]Contribute $250
[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/37555?refcode=em20230929-3875&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1015&akid=3875%2E614464%2EIWXB2c ]Give another amount

Thank you for taking action when it matters most,

Caleb Cavarretta
Campaign Manager

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe: https://act.lucaskunce.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe?t=1016&akid=3875%2E614464%2EIWXB2c

| | | For too long, the gun lobby has had immense power over our legislators. This election is a chance for us to put an end to it.

Our next FEC deadline is tomorrow night. These filings are public and if we have a strong showing we can prove the gun lobby isn’t the only one that can mobilize and that our collective action will beat their mega-donors.

**_[Will you chip in $10 today so our filing shows the strength of our community? ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953x1MMX4JH7QeXce3T0MICM8DA4dAy9bLf30MgdXD_CpZlw2hUlu0AQhPTmeXdbemahmuDkUott_u4vgo970olHYtE0OYjMhEYmselI-9a8Lprd9prOMcowOlBx934_rk8ryYUwoZd69tkDOKs6MlxY-ZX8QWcyoWNYON1Zm59aIrPXRrvMTRw93W4kaoEiTEEWUF4x1izpPCm5yPeiZm2UPonfaJneRcxKsKAVuDvMqWFJxXWdt3cj2_IgwypqZ4iQS-maaa6Dk9DLUgJpmSycEQWQScBfPeedf4UtDT2uyHUaqklCzRuwPon7aiGaEbQd4MLjH653U0uSW3qzSdql3/400/vOip_64QSqiohZY5i40UEQ/h0/bffrL835eSJ7DEuFUWHOwAgzZZZ7NeMgMUecQG5KZPo)_**

It is important, now more than ever, to fight for our safety.

body:
| | Peter,

My name is Fred Guttenberg. Since losing my daughter, Jaime, in the Parkland school shooting over five years ago, I’ve dedicated my life to trying to prevent more gun violence tragedies in America.

**That’s why I’m standing with Dr. Brian Williams in his campaign for Congress.** [Will you join me by contributing to his campaign now?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70621178/429909065/-1735495496?amount=10&source=EM_NBI_BW_20230929_FR_EOQ_0_3MO_FredGuttenberg_na_na_EOQ07&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDU5MjMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNGU3ZDM1OTAtZmU1ZS1lZTExLTk5MzctMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=f8_Ow5PuSMdC1_C_v-KQWD9MUYRbH2piZn9i1SYcDJ4=)

Peter, I remain hopeful because of the great people I have the good fortune of meeting, and Dr. Williams is one of them. He is a person who is putting himself out there because of what he has seen, and I know we need leaders like him to deal with the reality of gun violence in this country.

Working in the trauma centers across the country, Brian treated the never-ending flow of victims of gun violence, and he has had to tell far too many mothers that their children had died from gun violence. After a shooting in Dallas in 2016, he became the only surgeon in history to operate on multiple on-duty police officers victimized in a mass shooting. Ever since that night, he’s advocated for gun safety and an end to the epidemic of gun violence.

[Brian is facing the second Federal Election Commission (FEC) deadline of his campaign, and the first since the launch of his new ad, and he needs your help to have a strong report when his team closes the books on September 30th at midnight. Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is _personal_ and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by _immediately getting to work_ stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late. In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He's taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and **_won every single time_**. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon. _That's why he's running for President of the United States. | Meet **Mark Walker**

Congressman Mark Walker started his career in finance and, after earning his theology degree, Walker served 16 years as a pastor. In 2014, Walker stepped away from ministry and made a successful run for the U.S. Congress defeating a host of elected politicians. In 2015, Congressman Walker became the first member in an inaugural term to be elected Chair of the Republican Study Committee (RSC) - the largest caucus in Congress with 160 members and a position previously held by Vice President Pence and Congressman Jim Jordan.

In 2018, Walker was elected as Vice Chair of the entire conference, becoming the highest rated conservative to serve in the top four leadership positions in Congress. Walker is also the last member of Congress to secure a floor vote on a balanced budget amendment and led the House on HBCU initiatives winning the United Negro College Fund President’s list award. Congressman Walker served on multiple committees and in 2019, Walker was appointed to ranking member on the Committee on Homeland Security’s Intelligence and Counter-Terrorism’s subcommittee. Walker was co-chair of the bicameral prayer caucus for five years and also won the GOP MVP award as the starting pitcher on the Republican baseball team for the annual charity game.

Congressman Walker was redistricted out of his seat and stepped away from Congress in 2021. Walker ran for U.S. Senate in 2022 and was endorsed by Senators Tim Scott and James Lankford, Gov. Mike Huckabee, Hall of Fame Coach Tony Dungy and more than 200 pastors across North Carolina. Walker is currently the president of a political consulting business called Advancing Hope USA, and advocated for the two North Carolina Supreme Court candidates and 4 North Carolina Court of Appeals candidates through his independent expenditure organization, Win the Courts during this past general election. Congressman Walker and his wife Kelly, a Family Nurse Practitioner and flight trauma specialist, have been married for thirty years and have three children.

It’s Jeremy Spreitzer, I appreciate your support for my campaign. As some of you may know I have become an Independent Candidate and I want to emphasize that this is a pivotal moment that could determine our campaign's fate. Tomorrow, we're wrapping up this quarter and will publicly reveal our fundraising numbers. Remarkably, 100% of our donations originate from grassroots supporters like you. Your contribution today would have a profound impact, enabling us to make the necessary early investments for a successful run in the 2024 election. I understand that asking for support can be challenging, but given the significance of this moment, I sincerely request your contribution before our FEC deadline. Your support is truly vital. Please consider donating.

| |

| |

My Why

----------

I am deeply committed to being the voice for our neighborhood. It's a responsibility I take to heart because I believe that together, we can make positive changes that truly benefit our community. Whether it's advocating for better infrastructure, safer streets, or improved access to resources, I'm here to listen, understand, and represent your concerns. Together, we can build a stronger, more vibrant neighborhood where everyone's voice is heard and valued. Thank you for entrusting me with this important role. Our focus is on: Jobs, Water, Inflation, Social Security Protection, Medicare Protection, Veterans Benefits, Border Security, & Protecting NATO. We have much more to list and need representation on but we need your help!

Our grassroots campaign is focused on representing our community & Arizona’s best interests. As an Independent Candidate I am able to focus on what matters the most. YOU! We believe in giving every voice a chance to be heard. To support our campaign, I kindly ask you to sign my Candidate Petition for the General Election. If you are registered to vote in AZ-8, you are eligible to sign , your participation is crucial for our petition. I grew up in AZ-8 and would like to serve it in Congress. Our Platform Focus is putting the Neighborhood over party. Our Platform and policy stances have not changed for us but we are a grassroots campaign and want to focus on what matters the most in this election, the issues! We are headed to the General Election but need your help.

|

|

|

| |

Please help us spread the word by engaging in the grassroots efforts and sharing our message with All your family, neighbors, and friends. Together, BE THE CHANGE, let’s help unite and Put the neighborhood over party in AZ-8. We are Arizonans! Let's unite our neighborhoods and state and ensure we have the representation we deserve in Congress.

Thank you for your support. Please reach out with any questions or concerns. I look forward to working with you for a better future.
